Using teamwork and problem-solving skills, they overcame these challenges. Ella deciphered the riddle, revealing a hidden path that led them to the key. With the key, they unlocked the treasure: a glowing crystal with the power to help their village. Grandma Willow was proud of their determination and teamwork. Despite setbacks and harsh expectations, she learns to stand up for herself, grows braver in class, and slowly earns moments of pride from her parents. In the end, Ife begins to believe in her own worth, even if she's not perfect.

At school, they find each other and their mutual compliments spark newfound confidence. During break time, they connect with boys, Kgosi and Namjoon, who openly share their hair struggles. Together, they discover that everyone has unique hair challenges and then realize that their differences make them special. Join this vibrant group as they celebrate their individuality and the power of friendship in a world where self-expression reigns.

books.title: Ukuthanda izinwele zami
books.summary: Endabeni ethinta inhliziyo yobungane kanye nokuzamukela, usuku lukaLesego luqala ngokuhleka njengoba ubaba wakhe elungisa izinwele zakhe zibe izifutho ezimbili zokudlala. Esikoleni, uthola umoya wobungane kuJessica, futhi ukuncomana kwabo kuveza ukuzethemba okusha. Ngesikhathi sekhefu, baxhumana nabafana uKgosi kanye noNamjoon, abakhuluma ngokungananazi ngezinkinga zabo zezinwele. Ndawonye, ​​bathola ukuthi wonke umuntu unezinselele ezihlukile, kodwa umehluko wabo obenza bakhetheke. Joyina leli qembu elinempilo njengoba ligubha ubuntu babo namandla obungane emhlabeni lapho kubusa ukuziveza.

books.title: Simone moshanyana ya sebete.
books.summary: Simon e ne e le moshanyana ya dihlong ya neng a dula motseng wa Afrika. Ha a le dilemo di 13, o ile a tlameha ho paka sebete sa hae ka ho tšoasa phuti, jwalo ka bashanyana ba bang. A utlwa tsitsipano, Simon o ile a kena ka morung empa a sokola ho fumana phuti. Ka tšohanyetso, lengau le ile la mo hlasela! Sebakeng sa ho baleha, Simon o ile a lwana le lengau ka sebete mme a hlōla. O ile a kgutlela motseng e le mohale, a bontsha hore sebete sa nnete se tswa kahare.

books.title: Simon the brave boy
books.summary: Simon was a shy boy living in an African village. When he turned 13, he had to prove his bravery by catching a springbok, like the other boys. Feeling nervous, Simon entered the forest but struggled to find one. Suddenly, a leopard attacked him! Instead of running, Simon bravely fought the leopard and won. He returned to the village as a hero, showing that true courage comes from within.

books.title: Beertjie Groei Geduld
books.summary: Beertjie is in die wolke wanneer hy 'n saadjie kry wat hy besluit om te plant. Dae gaan verby sonder teken van groei, en Beertjie voel gefrustreerd. Terwyl hy uitdagings in sy lewe in die gesig staar, leer Beertjie die belangrikheid van geduld deur elke struikelblok wat hy oorkom. Hy ontdek dat geduld goeie dinge kan bring, en aan die einde van die week word hy beloon met 'n klein sonneblom wat in die tuin groei. Beertjie se storie wys jong lesers geduld te leer, en dit wys hulle dat dit laat wonderlike dinge gebeur.

books.title: Little Bear Grows Patience
books.summary: Little Bear is over the moon when he finds a seed that he decides to plant. Days go by with no sign of growth, and Little Bear feels frustrated. As he faces challenges in his everyday life, Little Bear learns the importance of patience through every obstacle he overcomes. He discovers that patience can bring good things, and at the end of the week, he is rewarded with a tiny sunflower growing in the garden. Little Bear's story aims to teach young readers patience, and it shows them that patience allows wonderful things to happen.

books.title: Bobby uyawa
books.summary: Bobby ugijimisa nogwaja bese awela emgodzinilomkhulu. Indzaba lemelula lenemisho lemifisha. Lesipele sibhalwe nga-2022 njengencenye yeprojekthi yekubambisana yeTipele tase-Afrika, i-British Council (Ningizimu Afrika), kanye neLitiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo (DBE SA)

books.title: Refiloe netinkhukhu letigeziwe
books.summary: Sisi wa-Refiloe uyashada. Tinkhukhu ta-Refiloe tingcole kakhulu futsi uncuma kutigezela umshado. Letinkhukhu atikutsandzi kugezwa. Refiloe akatitfoli tinkhukhu takhe nasekusikhatsi semshado, futsi bonkhe bantfu bayamangala.

books.title: Bobby o a wela
books.summary: Bobby o lelekisa mmutlanyana mme o wela ka hara mokoti o moholo. Ena ke pale e bonolo ya dipolelo tse kgutshwane. Pale ena e qapuwe ka 2022 e le karolo ya Projeke ya kopanelo e kenyeletsang African Storybookook,British Council (South Africa) le Department of Basic Education (DBE SA)

books.title: Refiloe le dikgoho tse hlatswitsweng
books.summary: Ausi wa Refiloe o a nyalwa. Dikgoho tsa Refiloe di a tshwehla, mme o nahana ho di hlatswetsa lenyalo. Dikgoho ha di rate ho hlatsuwa. Refiloe o sokola ho fumana dikgoho ha e se e le nako ya lenyalo, mme batho bohle ba emetswe ke dimakatso tse kgolo.

books.title: 'n Dag van Wegkruipertjie
books.summary: Dame Baa Baa die skaap, Kiki die kat en Tilly die skilpad spandeer die dag saam deur om wegkruipertjie te speel.

books.title: Refiloe le dikgogo tše di hlatswitšwego
books.summary: Sesi wa Refiloe o a nyalwa. Dikgogo tša Refiloe di šilafetše kudu gomme a tšea sephetho sa go di hlapiša pele ga lenyalo. Dikgogo ga di rate go hlapišiwa. Refiloe ga a hwetše dikgogo tša gagwe ka nako ya lenyalo, gomme seo ke semaka se segolo go bohle.

books.title: URefiloe nezinkukhu ezigeziwe
books.summary: Udadewabo kaRefiloe uyashada. Izinkukhu zikaRefiloe zingcole kakhulu futhi unquma ukuzigeza ezilungiselela umshado. Izinkukhu azithandi ukugezwa. URefiloe akazitholi izinkukhu zakhe uma sekuyisikhathi somshado, futhi wonke umuntu ulindelwe isimanga esikhulu.

books.title: UBobby uyawa
books.summary: UBobby ugijima elandela unogwaja bese ewela emgodini omkhulu. Indaba elula enemisho emifushane. Le ncwadi yezindaba yasungulwa ngo-2022 njengengxenye yephrojekthi yokubambisana ebandakanya i-African Storybook, British Council (South Africa), kanye noMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo (DBE SA)

books.title: URefiloe neenkukhu ezihlanjisiweko
books.summary: Udadwabo kaRefiloe uyatjhada. Iinkukhu zakaRefiloe zizele iinsila khulu begodu uqunta ukuzihlambisa ngombana kuzokuba nomtjhado. Iinkukhu azikuthandi ukuhlanjiswa. URefiloe akazitholi iinkukhu zakhe nasele kusikhathi somtjhado, begodu woke umuntu uzokumangala.

books.title: A Day of Hide and Seek
books.summary: Lady Baa Baa the sheep , Kiki the cat and Tilly the tortoise are spending the day playing hide and seek.

books.title: Ruby en Ruben se Perfekte Troeteldier.
books.summary: Ruby en Ruben is op soek na die perfekte troeteldier, maar hulle kan nie besluit watter een om te kies nie! Van 'n eend wat saam in waterplasse spat tot 'n kat wat snoesig in die bed lê, droom hulle oor allerhande diere. Maar elkeen het 'n klein probleem! Sal hulle ooit die regte troeteldier kry? Kom saam op hul prettige avontuur om uit te vind watter dier hul beste maatjie sal wees!

books.title: Ruby and Ruben's perfect pet
books.summary: Ruby and her brother Ruben want a pet but can't decide what kind to get. They imagine having all sorts of animals—ducks, bunnies, cats, lions, and more—each with its own fun and problems. In the end, they realize that a dog would be the perfect pet, and it becomes their best friend.

books.title: Kuvarura makovi (kutjekena mo)
books.summary: Esimwititi lyoku hamena kuvarura noku ligavera.

books.title: SIPHO
books.summary: Sipho wabona bantfu basesigodzini sangakubo badzinga kudla kudla lokunemphilo. Sipho wacala watjala timbidvo, titselo kanye nemmbila. Bantfu batfola kudla lokunemphilo.

books.title: TAIL OF GROWING UP
books.summary: Is a story about a young girl that was bullied for being friends with a dog.

books.title: Brilliant's triumph
books.summary: "Brilliant's Triumph" is a touching story about a young boy named Brilliant, born into poverty yet rich in dreams and determination. Despite facing ridicule and bullying at school due to his background, Brilliant's unwavering spirit and dedication to learning ultimately lead him to academic success, securing the top position in his class. Through his resilience and refusal to be defined by others' negativity, Brilliant teaches readers the invaluable lesson that with strength, perseverance, and self-respect, any challenge can be overcome. The story serves as a beacon of hope, inspiring young readers to confront adversity with courage and positivity, while emphasizing the importance of resilience and self-belief.

books.title: Ukuphumelela kwakaBrilliant
books.summary: "Ukuphumelela kwakaBrilliant" yindatjana ekhuluma ngomntwana ebekavela emndenini odabha phasi, bekenza ibanga lesithathu. Bekumntwana othanda isokolo, ozimiseleko begodu abotitjhere nababelethi bakhe bebazikhakhazisa ngaye. Umraro egade aqalene nawo esikolweni uBrilliant bekumraro wokutlhoriswa bafundi abavela emindenini edla izambane lakaponde. Nanyana gade bamutlhorisa wakwazi ukuthi aqine, azange abavumele bona behlise isithunzi sakhe. UBrilliant kwaba nguye umfundi odosa phambili ebangeni lakhe, lokhu kwarara abafundi laba egade bamutlhorisa bekwenza nokuthi bamuhloniphe, akhange basamutlhorisa. Indatjana le ifundisa abafundi bamabanga aphasi bona baqalane njani nokuthloriswa esikolweni, baqine, bazithembe, babekezele begodu bakholwe kobana enye nenye into iyafezeka epilweni namuzimiseko ngayo.

books.title: ማሙሽ ሊስትሮው
books.summary: ልጆች ከዚህ የምንረዳው ቤተሰቦቻችን ችግር ውስጥ ሲሆኑ ማገዝ እንዳለብን ፣ ከበድ ያለ ችግር ሲገጥመን ለወላጅ ፣ ለመምህር ፣ ለፖሊስ መናገር እንዳለብን እንረዳለን ።

books.title: Kuvarura makove (Kwita Mo)
books.summary: Mbapira ya maruvara ya vitimwitira. Mbapira ya muvaru ya kuhamena ku kuvarura na ku kugaunwina.(Mbapira yino ya vitimwitira kwa tikire muuta wa Kora mukuwana ntjontjo yatundiliro ku Oppenheimer Memorial Trust).

books.title: Ka Kusugh
books.summary: Iyange sev hungwa av tsô, mbayev mba kiriki za ishukôron shin kungwa. Wanye môm ken ve kôr ishu i cier iyol.

books.title: Andiswa mogaka wa kgwele ya dinao
books.summary: Andiswa o batla go tshameka kgwelw ya dinao le setlhopa sa sekolo mme mokatisi are kgwele ya dinao ke ya basimane fela. Andiswa o ne a bona chono ya go tshameka mo motshamekong o o botlhokwa go bontsha batho botlhe gore o a kgona.

books.title: Abbi le Laila
books.summary: Kgangnyana e e ka ga dinja tse pedi, Abbi le Laila. Di tswa kwa Johannesburg mo Aforika Borwa mme di rata go tshameka mo tshingwaneng le mo thabaneng,

books.title: Lindo the Recycling star
books.summary: This story is about Lindo a little girl that goes on a quest to find recyclable materials and uses them to build new mats for her friends and family with the aim to make everyone happy while keeping the environment clean and beautiful.

books.title: Timmy Tells Mommy
books.summary: Timothy an Eight year old boy tells her mother all the environmental wrongs he sees everyday.

books.title: Colourful fruit
books.summary: Mum loves the colour of fruit. She loves her children. How does she put these two things together? Let's find out.

books.title: Lebo goes to the library
books.summary: Lebo has been looking for new books to read but she can't find any! That is, until, Pumi teachers her about the library!

books.title: Jenny's adventure
books.summary: Once apron a time there was a mommy owl and her four babies. Three of them were very well-behaved, and then there was Jenny. Jenny had a will of her own and it often got her into trouble.

books.title: Zama Wamaanyi!
books.summary: Olugero luno luteesa nti newankubadde tugunjula abaana, tulina okubatendereza kwebyo byebabeera batukiriza.

books.title: Mme
books.summary: Kgang ka ga lorato lwa ga mme mo go nna jaaka ngwana a le esi. O nthata thata le nna ke a mo rata

books.title: Itiang luko Uganda
books.summary: Nuikamunitos itiang luejaasi Uganda, iboro lu enyamete kesi, aiboisio nu iboiete kesi keda iriaginikec.

books.title: Die wyse donkie
books.summary: Dis n storie oor n wyse donkie. Die storie was ontwikkel as deel van n Lenovo geborgde projek wat as n toets vir Afrika storieboek applikasie toel by biblioteke gedoen was. Die storie is ontwikkel by n werkswinkel in Ras Abebe AREgay Biblioteek,Derby Birhan,Ethipie in 2022.

books.title: Die padda en die slang
books.summary: Die storie leer ons dat nie al ons vriende eerlik is met ons

books.title: Zinhle Recycling Adventure
books.summary: This story is about the importance of recycling and Zinhle goes on a fun-filled adventure to explore how animals, food, and transportation can be related to recycling.

books.title: Je Peux Le Faire!
books.summary: Dande se réveille et pense: « Aujourd'hui, c'est mon premier jour d'école. »

books.title: Écoute!
books.summary: Écoute les différents cris des animaux. Les cris des animaux sont differents les uns des autres.

books.title: J'aime lire!
books.summary: Voici l'histoire d'un petit garçon qui aime lire des histoires. Il aime tellement la lecture qu'il veut partager une histoire avec sa famille.

books.title: Mes Amis!
books.summary: L'histoire d'un garçon et de ses amis, et des activités qu'ils aiment faire.

books.title: Adama est formidable !
books.summary: Cette histoire suggère que, tout en disciplinant les enfants, nous devons aussi faire l'éloge de leurs succès quotidiens.

books.title: Pourquoi le crapaud est-il si laid?
books.summary: Ce conte populaire du Mozambique nous raconte pourquoi crapaud est si laid.

books.title: Un handicap n'est pas une incapacité
books.summary: Ce texte nous montre le handicap n'empêche pas de travailler.

books.title: La grande sècheresse et Beelel Barka!
books.summary: Confrontés à une longue saison sèche, les animaux font preuve de solidarité pour surmonter le problème.

books.title: Le poisson électrique!
books.summary: Un groupe d'enfants se rend à la rivière pour pêcher. L'un d'eux attrape un poisson inconnu qui s'avère dangereux.

books.title: La Maîtresse Saratou!
books.summary: Une histoire courte et simple sur une maîtresse formidable et ce qu'elle nous apprend.

books.title: The Lost Ball
books.summary: Tommy loses his ball and needs hep to find it.

books.title: Busy Englishers
books.summary: Classroom storytelling friendship, pets and helping at home

books.title: Bune
books.summary: This is a story about a play game called Bune. In this game kids play by touching each other in return of running till one is caught up. This story teaches about the danger of Corona Virus among children.

books.title: ህ ይን ውዓግን
books.summary: መስሐ'ት ነበረያ ነበረ እያ። ብ ዛዕባ ዕርክነትን ካብ ጕንቦ ምሸላ ዝተረኸበ ትርፍን ተዘንትው።

books.title: ክንደይ?
books.summary: እዙ መፅሓፍ ብ ዛዕባ ምቝፃር እይዩ። ኣብ ቶም ስእልታት ክንደይ ነገራት ኣልለዉ? መጀምመርታ ኣፀብቢቕኩም ኣንቢብኩም፡ ካብኡ ቈፂርኩም መልልሱ።

books.title: Sisi the Squirrel
books.summary: In Marere village, clever squirrel Sisi and her friends Kibo and Jengo discover sparkling maize. They learn the value of sharing from Mama Kazi, the farmer.

books.title: Bella's Magical Paintbrush
books.summary: Bella, a young artist, wanted to surprise her mom on her birthday. She decided to paint a landscape of Mount Kenya but struggled with mixing the right shades of paint. Bella learned about color mixing from a library book and YouTube tutorials, enhancing her skills. Her vibrant painting impressed her mother, who encouraged her to continue. Bella's dedication paid off, and she became a renowned artist known for her beautiful landscapes and unique color-blending abilities.

books.title: My dog.
books.summary: The story is about a boy named Sammy and the called Molly. Sammy took his dog for a walk in the forest, and it got lost while taking a walk.

books.title: uSibi noSgojwana
books.summary: Indatjana le imayelana nezinja ezimbili u Sibi noSgojwana. izinjezi zazihlakaniphe khulu zikwazi ukuzikhambela ziyokufuna iinyamazana emangweni zizodwa.

books.title: The mysterious garden
books.summary: The story follows three friends, Ben, Max, and Karabo, who embark on a journey to find a mysterious garden rumored to be magical. Upon entering the garden, they are enchanted by its beauty but are warned by Max not to take anything from it. Despite his warning, Karabo and Ben pick flowers from the garden, leading to a series of misfortunes in their lives. Realizing their mistake, they return the flowers to the garden, hoping to rectify their actions. Through this experience, they learn the importance of respect and the consequences of taking what isn't theirs. The story concludes with the trio walking away from the garden, carrying the memory of its magic with them forever, but understanding that some mysteries are meant to be respected, not exploited.

books.title: Prayer for rain
books.summary: It have not rained for a long time, the community gathered to pray for the rain.What was a blessing it turned into a disaster.

books.title: Ukuthandazela izulu
books.summary: umphakathi ekhabe utlhoga izulu kwathi langelinye bahlangana bathandazela izulu nangambala lana kwafika lapho lenza iinkhukhula ezaphetha ngokumotjha izinto.

books.title: Fun summer
books.summary: The story is about two siblings, Bony and Biggy, and their dog Furry who enjoyed playing with the water sprinkles in the hot summer days. They loved each other so much that they did not want to see the other person sad and would do anything to put a smile on their faces again.

books.title: Paws and claws.
books.summary: The story "Paws and Claws" is a heartwarming tale about a happy family and their special furry friends - Max the playful puppy, Whiskers the fluffy white cat, and Polly the chirpy parrot. The family gathers to learn how to care for their pets, ensuring their happiness and health. They discover the importance of feeding each pet their specific food, providing fresh water daily, keeping them clean and cozy, and showering them with love and attention. The story ends with the family and their pets content, knowing they are loved and cared for in their forever home.

books.title: The Magical Transport Parade.
books.summary: In the whimsical town of Whimsyville, the annual Magical Transport Parade brings vehicles and animals to life in a lively celebration. Coco the bear, along with his friends Lulu, Sammy, and Mia, eagerly prepares to join the parade. Each friend has a unique mode of transport: Lulu on her speedy scooter, Sammy in his hot air balloon, and Mia on her magical broomstick. As the parade begins, they face challenges inspired by various modes of transport, testing their courage and teamwork. Despite obstacles, they support each other, learning about teamwork and problem-solving. In the end, they reach the grand finale, showcasing their talents and celebrating diversity and friendship.

books.title: Diphoofolo tša ka gae.
books.summary: "Diphoofolo tša ka gae" ke kanegelo ye e ruthetšago pelo ka lapa le le thabilego le bagwera ba bona ba ba kgethegilego ba boya - Pule mpšanyana ya go bapala, Mmabotse katse ye tšhweu ya go ba le mafofa, le Mmala nonyana yeo e bolelago ya go thabelago go opela. Lapa le ile la kgobokana go ithuta ka moo ba ka hlokomelago diphoofolo tša bona tša ka gae, le kgonthišetša lethabo la tšona le bophelo bjo bobotse. Ba ile utolla bohlokwa bja go fepa phoofolo e nngwe le e nngwe ya lapeng ka go di fa dijo tša tšona tše di kgethegilego, go di nea meetse a hlwekilego tšatši ka tšatši, go di boloka di hlwekile e bile di le mabothobotho le go di fa lerato le tlhokomelo. Kanegelo e fela ka diteng tša lapa le diphoofolo tša bona tša ka gae, ba tseba gore di a ratwa le go hlokomelwa ka gae ga bona ka mo go sa felego.

books.title: Kefilwe's dancing dream
books.summary: This is a story about a young girl who was passionate about music and dancing. She was disabled but a dreamer of being a dancer in a wheelchair. The Lord helped her to have the braveness and skill of a dancer. After all, she finally conquered challenges and became the best dancer in a wheelchair.

books.title: Matšatši a selemo
books.summary: Padi ye e bolela ka bana ba babedi e le go Shiela le Neo, le mpša ya bona yeo e bitšwago Sibi. Ba be ba rata kudu ebile ba bapala mmogo. Ba be ba sa rate go bona yo mongwe a nyamile, ebile ba leka ka mahlo go bontšhana lethabo.

books.title: Max na Magudumane lonemusa
books.summary: Ngalelinye lilanga bekukhona umnenke libito lakhe kungu Max. Max bekasilwanywana labesihlala sisodvwa sitfungatsana nemngani langadlala naso. Tilwanyana lebetikhona ehlatsini lebekahlala kulo betimatasa ngetintfo tato tingamunaki Max. kwatse ngalelinye lemelanga Max wahlangana naMagudvumane lolungile, wacelala kudlala naye kute atokhona kucedza lesitunge lanaso. Magundvumane wavumela etulu, lelo langa kwaba kutjintja kwemphilo yaMax

books.title: Luhambo lwa Lily lolujabulisako
books.summary: Kulendzaba lejabulisako, Lily ubuyela edolobheni lakubo futsi uhlele umhlangano wekuhlola imiva. Ngemisebenti leyehlukehlukene kanye netingcoco, lomphakatsi ufundza kuveta nekucondza injabulo, lusizi, intfukutselo nekwesaba. Bakha indzawo lephephile futsi leyesekelako lapho wonkhe umuntfu ativa akhululekile kucoca ngendlela lativa ngayo. Lokuhlangenwe nako lokushintjako kuholela ekwemukelweni kwemiva kanye nekuvisisa ngekhatsi kwemphakatsi.

books.title: Nomvula
books.summary: In Africa, a small village lived in harmony with their land, tending crops and livestock. However, their land began to wilt and trees droop. The villagers called their wise elder Nomvula, who listened to their concerns and prayed for rain and land healing. After two days, rain began to fall, bringing happiness to the villagers.

books.title: Moose, the naughty bull
books.summary: Long ago Ouma Joyce had ten cows and a dog that was very intelligent. Raven the Dog would solely put all the cows in the Kraal and he would count them one by one as they go in . Raven would notice whenever the cows were missing and he would go into the woods to look for the missing cows . Every morning Raven would open the gate with his teeth and count the cows from ten to the last one as they went out to drink water and eat grass.

books.title: Ikunzana etshwenyako u Mandlakhe
books.summary: Ekadeni kwakukhona isalukazana ebesithanda ifuyo khulu ngendlela esimanga. Isalukazanesi sasi nekunzana eyayilihlupho eenkomeni zaso ithanda ukubaleka iye esigangeni. Isalukazi lesi kazi besinenja eyayihlakaniphe kwamanikelela. Inja le yayibizwa ngo Nzimanzima. UNzimanzima waye anekghono lokubona lokha iinkomo zingakapheleli ngesibayeni, bese angene isiganga ayokuzuma ikunzana u Mandlakhe!

books.title: Ikhambo likaZweli lokuya eSikolweni.
books.summary: indatjana le! imayelana nekhambo likaZweli lokuya esikolweni. lapho ebegade akhamba ngebhesi eyabhala uyakha yafika endleleni yambala ukukhamba kwathi uNomzana uNkambule abiza khona itekisi ukobana ibathathe ibase esikolweni. kwathi uZweli nakafika esikolweni watjela abangani bakhe nge khambo lakhe lokufika esikolweni. nabo abangani bakhe azange bazibeke phasi batjho ukobana nabo beze bunjeni esikolweni. wokuthoma wathi yena uze nesitimela, kwalandela umunye wathi yena uze ngekoloyi kanokutjho wamaswapela yena wathi uze ngetsikiri etja ukuze abfike esikolweni.

books.title: Let it rain
books.summary: In Africa, a small village lived in harmony with their land, tending crops and livestock. However, their land began to wilt and trees droop. The villagers called their wise elder Nomvula, who listened to their concerns and prayed for rain and land healing. After two days, rain began to fall, bringing happiness to the villagers.

books.title: kutiphatsa kabi kwa Daisy epulazini.
books.summary: Daisy, inkhomo lendze, uhlala aletsa tinkinga wate wagicita igandaganda yemlimi yabese ishayisa sihlahla. Umphumela waloko uba kutsi atfole umsebenti lomnyenti futsi abe nesikhatsi lesinyenti sekutivocavoca, afundze kusebenta kahle futsi abambisane nemnikati welipulazi, lokumenta ametsembe.

books.title: MY BICYCLE
books.summary: Zoe was an 8 years old boy. He was the only son to his parent. His father worked as a carpenter and his mother was a home maker. Although Zoe's family was not a rich one, they lead a happy life.Zoe's school was located a mile away from his home. Zoe's birthday was coming up in a week. He requested his father to buy him a bicycle, so that he can go to school in cycle and not by walk and depend on his father to drop him at school. His father also promised him to buy a bicycle so that he need not walk to school anymore. Zoe felt so happy.

books.title: Phetogo ya Tšhwene e Nnyane
books.summary: Mo toropong ya Maganasburg, Tšhwene e nyaka dijo go baagišani eupša e a ganwa. Ka ge a swerwe ke tlala, o gwerana le Hare, gomme ba utolla dijo ka ntlong yeo e tlogetšwego. Ge a swere ke mong, Kganya, Tšhwene o kgopela tshwarelo gomme o thuša go hlwekiša. Kganya o mo swarela, gomme ba tlemagana. Tšhwene o a mpshafatša, a boloka legae la gagwe le hlwekile le go gwerana le baagišani. Ba abelana dijo gomme ba phela ka lethabo.

books.title: The Transformation of Young Monkey
books.summary: In the small town of Maganasburg, a lazy and messy creature named Young Monkey is constantly seeking food without offering help or taking responsibility. Rejected by his neighbors for his irresponsible behavior, Young Monkey teams up with Hare to explore an old house filled with food. Caught by the homeowner, Kganya, Young Monkey promises to clean up in exchange for forgiveness. With the help of Hare, Young Monkey learns the value of responsibility and friendship. He transforms his ways, keeping his home clean and becoming a helpful member of the community, eventually gaining the respect of his neighbors.

books.title: Peu e nnyane e ya leoto le le telele
books.summary: Kanagelo ye e bolela ka peu e nnyane yeo e be go e se na le boitshepho mo go yona, ebile e be e sa nyake go gola gore e tle swane le matšoba a mangwe ka mo serapeng sa kgaswi le skolo. E fela ka morago ga go etela ke bana ba ba raro bao e lego Lethabo, Amogelang le Sadie, Sammy o feleleditše a kgona go tšeya sephetho sa gore o tlo gola a swana le matšoba a mangwe ka mo serapeng

books.title: Thuto ya tate
books.summary: Abula o be a sa rate go bala. Tatago Abula o ile a mofa maele a gore a rate dipuku le sekolo. O nagana eng ka maele a tatago Abula?

books.title: Billy's adventure
books.summary: This book is about a boy named Billy, who owns a dog called Dogie, He lives with his grandmother. One morning Billy wakes up and eats his breakfast before going for his walk. After he was done eating he went outside and found his dog playing after that he said his goodbyes to his grandmother and heads out. Billy walks with his dog through the forest and admire the beautiful green plants and trees, in he middle of their walk Dogie gets excited and runs of where Billy cannot see him anymore. Then he starts getting worries and looks for Dogie but there is no sign of him. While Dogie also get sad of getting lost in the forest. Billy then returns home to tell his grandmother about what had happened and his grandmother comforts his and tells him that Dogie will come back. Just then Dogie appears and they all became happy again.

books.title: Ikhambo lakaBilly
books.summary: Incwadi le ikhuluma ngomsanyana ohlala nogogwakhe begodu onenjana enzima. Ngelinye ilanga ekuseni wavuka wayokudla sukela lapho wathatha injakhe bathatha ikhambo labo lekuseni baya ngehlathini. Kuthe basakhamba njalo inja le yathaba khulu yagijima yangena ehlathini yalahlekela umnikazi. Sukela lapho uBilly wathoma ukukhathazeka nasolo abona inja yakhe ingabuyi, wagcina sele abuyela ekhaya wafika wabikela ugogwakhe ngesehlakalo esenzakeleko. Ugogwakhe wamcolisa ngokumtjela bonyana izinja ziyakwazi laoha zihlala khona izokubuya. Kuthe kusese njalo uBilly wezwa inja ikhonkotha ngaphandle wathi nakaphumako wabona injakhe bagijimelana begodu bajabulile.

books.title: Dijo tša phepo di bohlokwa
books.summary: Kanegelo ye e bolela ka lesogana leo le bitšwago Pule. Pule ke mošemane wa go rata goja dijo tša go hloka phepho. O ithatela dijo tša makhura le malekere kudu. Koko wa gae oile a mo ruta ga mmogo le bana ba gabo gore go bohlokwa kudu goja dijo tša phepo tša go swana le merogo le dienywa. Ka letšatši le lengwe pule o ile a hlagela ke kotsi ka lebaka la goja dijo tša go hloka phepo. Ka morago ga tiragalo yeo, Pule o ile a lemoga bohlokwa bja goja dijo tša phepo.

books.title: Kgomotso and the Fruit basket.
books.summary: Kgomotso lived with his grandmother whom they all called koko, and his two siblings Diketso and Phuthi. They lived in harmony in their small village. Kgomotso's grandmother used to bring fruits and vegetables from the market every month after social grants were paid. Kgopotso loved eating fruits and vegetables. One morning koko came back from the market with a basket full of fruits. Koko taught her 3 grandchildren to always share because sharing is caring . Kgomotso decided to be naughty and ate all the fruits in the basket. He blamed his younger brother when Koko asked who ate the fruits. Little did he know that the truth always come to light, something happened to him that forced him to tell the truth. at the end he apologized for lying and for eating all the fruits.

books.title: Hare the hero
books.summary: Lizzy is seen in her home excited to start her first day at school. Lizzy prepares to go to her school and her mother is making her a lunch box. Lizzy and Refilwe leave home to school as they walked on the pedestrian side of the road.Lizzy and Refilwe encounters a crossroad for which the school is on the other side. They does not understand road signs, and as a result they are stuck on the crossroad unable to cross. As Lizzy and Refilwe were frustrated, there came Hare. Hare was wearing a cape and had a short tail. Hare helped the two little girls understand the road signs at the cross road. Hare, Refilwe and Lizzy jump the cross road. Even after school Lizzy and Refilwe are seen able to cross the road by themselves.

books.title: Penny the Pig and Max the Dog
books.summary: Once upon a time, in a peaceful farm, there lived two best friends named Penny the Pig and Max the Dog. Penny was a curious and adventurous pig who loved exploring every nook and cranny of the farm. Max, on the other hand, was a loyal and playful dog who always looked out for his friend Penny.

books.title: Bagwera ba bagolo elego Penny le Max
books.summary: Kgalekgale, polaseng ya khutšo, go be go dula bagwera ba babedi ba bagolo bao ba bitšwago Penny elego Kolobe le Max elego Mpša. Penny e be e le kolobe ya go rata go tseba le ya go rata go dira dilo tše di sa tlwaelegago yeo e bego e rata go hlahloba sekhutlwana se sengwe le se sengwe sa polasa. Ka lehlakoreng le lengwe, Max e be e le mpša e botegago le e bapalago yeo ka mehla e bego e lebelela mogwera wa yona Penny.

books.title: TALE YA GO GOLA
books.summary: Ke kanegelo ya ngwanenyana yo monnyane yo a ilego a tlaišwa ka lebaka la go ba mogwera le mpša.

books.title: Joy, the tailless dog
books.summary: In Fernie, a dog named Joy, born without a tail, was adored by everyone, including his owner, Tony. One day, they met Mr. Sibeko, who invited Joy to participate in a dog race. Joy, despite being ridiculed by other dogs, he eagerly prepared for the race. On the day of the race, Joy led the pack, chanting "Go Joy, Go Joy." Tony was thrilled to see Joy leading the race, and Mr. Sibeko congratulated him and gave him a trophy. He also announced Joy as the leader of a dog community exercise club, where all dogs in the district gather to keep their bodies healthy.

books.title: Jabulile inja lengenamsila
books.summary: EFernie, kunenja lebitwa ngekutsi nguJabulile, leyatalwa ite umsila, futsi bonkhe bantfu bebayitsandza, lokufaka ekhatsi nemnikati wayo, longuThabo. Ngalelinye lilanga, bahlangana naMnumzane Sibeko, lowamema Jabulile kutsi ahlanganyele emjahweni wetinja. Jabulile, nanobe abehlekwa nguletinye tinja, abelungiselela lomncintiswano ngekutimisela. Ngelilanga lemncintiswano, Jabulile abehamba embili, ahlabela atsi "fakumoya Jabu, fakumoya". Thabo wajabula kakhulu nakabona Jabulile ahola lomncintiswano, bese kutsi Mnumzane Sibeko wambingelela futsi wamniketa sigcoko se mpumelelo. Waphindze wamemetela kutsi Jabulile utawuba ngumholi welicembu letinja letidlala imidlalo yekutivocavoca, lapho khona tonkhe tinja talesigodzi tihlangana khona kute tihlale tiphilile.

books.title: Pabi and her precious cat Kabu
books.summary: The story is about a little girl with her precious cat named Kabu. She loved her cat so much that she played with it every single day but as time goes on her cat Kabu got sick and died. She became very lonely that her mother bought her another cat in replacement of Kabu at first, she was still thinking about the old cat but got used to the new cat as time goes by.

books.title: Umrhubhululi uMolly
books.summary: Indatjana le ikhuluma ngomntazana uMolly obekafuna ukwazi ngemisebenzi abantu abayenzako. Wathoma irhubhululo lakhe ukuze athole ilwazi ngemisebenzi yabantu.

books.title: Temalangeni nelivivane .
books.summary: Bekune ntfombatane lehlala emakhaya, itsandza ingandzi yakhe lelinetimbali letinhle, nemavivane lanembala lomuhle kakhulu, kodvwa yinye lenhle kunato tonkhe, livivave Buhle. Kwatsi ngalelinye lilanga kwafika indodza ledzala yatjontja lelivivane lelihle kakhulu. Intfombatane , watame ngako konkhe lekuse mandleni wasita lelivivane, ngekuniketa lendvodza imbali yesimanga lenhle kakhulu. Sukela lapho, intfombi Amelia wacinisekisa kutsi lendvodza asabidvutane nemavivane akhe lamahle kakhulukati, livivane buhle.

books.title: ILanga lokuya eZoo
books.summary: Abantrazinyana ababili uZanele no Zinhle bavakatshela eZoo esendaweni ye Kwagga. Bebayokuqala iinlwana ezihlala eZoo. Bathe nabafika lapha babona iinlwane ezinengi kwamambala. Ngokuphazima kwelihlo uEmily wabona bona kukhona into engasirerhe ngendlovu encani uLilly. UZanee wagijima wayokubiza uMr Dube umphathi wenlwane. Weza warhelebha indlovu encani yatjhaphuluka.

books.title: Tšhengwana ya Lethabo le Thabang
books.summary: Motseng wo o bitšwago gaPhahla, go be go nale lapa la ba bane, go akaretša le mafahla a mengwaga ye šupa Lethabo le Thabang, le be le dula kgauswi le sediba. Papadi ya mafahla yeo ya meetse e ile ya dira gore sediba se šilafale, gomme ya baka mathata go badudi ba motse bao ba bego ba ithekgile ka sona bakeng sa kabo ya bona ya meetse. Ka letšatši le lengwe, badudi ba motse ba ile ba bona mafahla ao gomme ba a raka. Tatago bona, Malose, o ile a nagana gore ba dire tšemo ye nnyane moo ba ka nošetšago dibjalo letšatši le letšatši. Lethabo le Thabang ba ile ba kgetha sepeneše le ditamati, ba kgetha sepeneše ka lebaka la mehola ya sona ya maphelo le ditamati ka baka la diteng tša yona tša bithamine C. Malose o ile a ba thuša go bjala dienywa le merogo yeo ba e kgethilego, gomme tšhengwana e ile ya fetoga tsela e botse ya gore ba diriše meetse.

books.title: Disobedient twins
books.summary: The story centres on Peter and Peterson, two brothers known for their laziness and disobedience. One day, their father tasked them with delivering bananas to their grandmother's house. Due to their laziness, they opted for a shortcut. En route, they encountered a monkey, which devoured all

books.title: Kubala kwaThandi epaki.
books.summary: Thandi, umntfwana lofuna kwati kubala, ujoyina uMnumzane Dlamini ekubaleni tintfo lebetikhona tisepaki.

books.title: Hazel's Counts at the Park
books.summary: A curious child, Hazel joins Mr. Brown, a friendly park ranger, on an adventure of counting! They explore the park together, counting colorful flowers, swings on the playground, and even friendly squirrels. through this playful learning experience, Hazel discovers the importance of numbers and how they help us compare and explore the world around us.

books.title: Nthati and Thabo's little garden
books.summary: In a village called gaPhahla, a family of four, including seven-year-old twins Nthati and Thabo, lived by a serene pond. The twins' water play caused the pond to become dirty, causing problems for the villagers who relied on it for their water supply. One day, the villagers saw the twins and chased them away. Their father, Jimmy, suggested they create a little garden where they could water plants daily. Nthati and Thabo chose spinach and tomatoes, choosing spinach for its health benefits and tomatoes for its vitamin C content. Jimmy helped them plant their chosen fruits and vegetables, and the garden became a productive and positive way for them to use water. The community members were relieved, and Nthati and Thabo enjoyed a delicious meal made from their labor, bringing joy to the family.

books.title: Home Sweet Home; A Tale of Animal Dwellings.
books.summary: "Home Sweet Home: A Tale of Animal Dwelling" tells the story of various animals and their unique homes. From ant hills to bird nests, the book explores how different animals build their shelters and create safe spaces for themselves and their families. Through colorful illustrations and simple text, readers are introduced to the diverse ways in which animals adapt to their environments and create their own versions of 'home sweet home'. The book emphasizes the importance of shelter and highlights the creativity and resourcefulness of the animal kingdom. It is a heartwarming and educational read for children of all ages.

books.title: Mapule le senatla
books.summary: Go kanegelo ya Mapule le senatla ,mmago Mapule o mo tlogela a nnoši ka motseng wa gabo. O ile a mo tlogela ka ge a e ya mašemong . Mmagwe o ile a mo tshepiš gore otlamo tlišetša dijo, efela Senatla satla go thopa Mapule.

books.title: Sophie and the Giant's Tale
books.summary: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sophie who lived in a small village with her mom. Her dad had passed away, so it was just the two of them. One day, Sophie's mom said they were going to move to a new place to start over. Sophie didn't want to leave their old home, and she cried because she didn't want to go.

books.title: Alina is saving water
books.summary: The story is about Alina illustrating the importance of conserving water, especially during drought. She calls the community to come together to reduce their water usage and eventually ended the drought, showing that even small actions can make a big difference.

books.title: Ubuntu at the zoo.
books.summary: Grade 3 learners were excited about a zoo trip. Sam forgot his lunchbox but Kevin shared his. Kevin applied math skills to divide the food equally, showing kindness to his friend Sam. They enjoyed their zoo trip together.

books.title: Tentile utfwala lichaza lakhe !
books.summary: Tentile uyintfombatana lencane lengatitsatsi tibopho tetento tayo. Ngalelinye lilanga wahlangabetana nesimo lesimatima. Loku kutawushintja yini kutiphatsa kwaTentile? Asesibone!

books.title: Themba nenja levilaphako
books.summary: Lendzaba ikhuluma ngaThemba, umfana lomuhle futsi losebenta ngekutimisela endzaweni lencane, lowakha bungani nenja levilaphako. Umusa waThemba uyigucula lenja, futsi baba bangani labakhulu. Bahlangana ndzawonye, basindzisa inyoni lencane futsi baba ngemachawe kulesigodzi, bafundzisa wonkhe umuntfu ngemandla elutsandvo kanye nekunakekela. Lendzaba igcizelela bungani, umusa kanye nemandla ekuba neluvelo kanye nesihawu.

books.title: Molemi le mehlare ba phološa letšatši
books.summary: Kanegelo e lebane kudu le molemi yo a bego a abelana polasa ya gagwe le mpša, kgomo le pudi. Molemi o ile a nea mpša e bota kudu gomme a e laela ka mehla mabapi le seo e swanetšego go se dira ge e se gona. Go tlaleletša, molemi o ile a tloga polaseng gomme a tlogela mpša ka ditaelo ka ge pudi le kgomo di be di na le botumo bja go se kwe melao. Diphoofolo tše dingwe di ile tša hlokomologa ditaelo tša mpša gomme tša phušola polasa mola molemi a be a etetše bomalome ba gagwe. Mpša e ile ya swanelwa ke go ya go tšea molemi ge ditaba di gola, gomme ya dira bjalo ka go latela monkgo wa gagwe. Ka morago ga go tsebišwa ka seemo, molemirui o ile a swanelwa ke go tloga e sa le ka pela go netefatša bophelo bjo bobotse bja diphoofolo tša polasa. Go netefatša gore diphoofolo di na le dijo le tšhireletšo go letšatši.

books.title: THE MIRACULOUS GRASSHOPPER
books.summary: Once upon a time there was John who like catching grasshopper, one day he met the Miraculous grasshopper and the grasshopper tricked John to end up being in a mountain where he was not supposed to go, because there was a big scary monster.

books.title: Themba and the lazy dog
books.summary: The story revolves around Themba, a kind and hardworking boy in a small village, who befriends a lazy dog. Themba's kindness transforms the dog, and they become inseparable friends. Together, they rescue a baby bird and become heroes in the village, teaching everyone the power of love and care. The story highlights themes of friendship, kindness, and the transformative impact of empathy and compassion

books.title: Peter The Sparrow
books.summary: Introduction: The story revolves around a young sparrow named Peter who was out searching for food in the forest.Conflict: While trying to catch a worm, Peter is threatened by a Cat who wants to make him its meal. Just as the Cat is about to grab Peter, a great horned Owl appears and saves Peter by snatching the Cat away.Resolution: The Owl drops the Cat into a lake, ensuring it never returns. Grateful for being saved, Peter befriends the Owl and learns valuable lessons about survival in the forest.Conclusion: Peter becomes wise and knowledgeable under the guidance of the Owl, thanks to their newfound friendship.

books.title: Molly the researcher!
books.summary: The story is about a little girl named Molly. Molly wants to celebrate career day at school. She then researches about the jobs people do. Later on, she has decided what she wants to become when she grows up.

books.title: The Missing Rabbit
books.summary: The story is about a big rabbit family living on a farm. One of the baby rabbits goes missing, causing concern. The family searches and eventually finds the missing baby, learning the importance of staying together and being careful.

books.title: Nicholas wants a snake as a pet.
books.summary: The story is about a little boy named Nicholas who lived with his father. His father owned a dog named spotty the problem is that Nicholas did not like the snake and wanted to have a snake as a pet. His father bought a cat and thought Nicholas will have a friend but Nicholas told his father that he wants a snake. Nicholas's father told him that a snake is dangerous and taught him about animals that can be kept as pets.

books.title: UJabu ufuna ukupuya inyoka.
books.summary: Indatjana le imayelana nomsana obizwa ngoJabu obekahlala noyise. bekunomraro okhona ekuhlalisaneni kwabo. umraro bekukobana ekhabo kunenja yena ufuna inyoka. kodwana uyise wamufundisa bona iinyoka ziyingozi akusiso isilwane angasifuya ngendlini.

books.title: Indlovu nabantwana bayo.
books.summary: Indlovo esikazi beyihlala nabantwana bayo uTingo noTemu, bezihlala ngokuthula ehlathini. uTingo noTemu bebathanda ukudlala kodwana unina wabo begade abakhumbuza kobana bangadlaleli kude khulu ukuze baphephe.

books.title: Serapana Sa Kolo
books.summary: Ka mokgwa wo Kolo a ithutileng go hlokomela tilologo ka go bjala.

books.title: Kelly takes responsibility!
books.summary: Kelly is a young girl who doesn't take responsibility for her actions. One day, she faces a tough situation. Will this change Kelly's behavior? Let's see!

books.title: Inja ebuthaka.
books.summary: Isitori lesi simayelana nenja eyathathwa ngu Jabu endleleni .UJabu wayithiya igama wathi ngu Bhobi.UBhobi yinja enza izinto ezingakajayeleki ngombana ukhamba kabuthaka begodu akabonakali anepilo njengezinye izinja.Inja le yathi ngelinye ilamnga idlala nomnganayo uMonki yawa.Umnikazi wayo wayisa emtholapilo wenlwane.Wathukwa khulu nakathola bona inja yakhe iyagula begodu iguliswa kukudla akupha yona.

books.title: Nomsa and the garden.
books.summary: The story is about a girl named Nomsa and her mother visiting her grandmother's house. She got to see the garden when she arrived, to see the beautiful vegetable garden at Grandma's house. The girl is excited to help her grandmother plant and water the vegetables, showing her love for nature and gardening. The story highlights the bond between family members and the joy of spending time in a garden. The story introduces the characters of Nomsa, her mother, and her grandmother, highlighting their differing lifestyles and interest. Her mother persuades her by promising that she will learn something valuable from the experience. Nomsa was captivated by the vegetable garden. She actively engages with her grandmother in planting and harvesting.

books.title: The road accident that made Thembi a hero
books.summary: This a story about a young girl Thembi who went to the shops with her brother. On their way going there something bad happened. The was a car accident in the road. Thembi was able to assist by calling the emergency number.

books.title: Umntazana ohlakaniphileko
books.summary: Indatjana le ikhuluma ngoNomvula umntazana ohlakaniphileko owakghona ukusiza abantu ebabalimele engozini eyenzeka hlangana nemodere nelori.

books.title: Georgie's Green Scarf.
books.summary: A story about a Giraffe losing a scarf and his zoo friends help in finding it.

books.title: The slow dog
books.summary: The story is about a dog that was named Rex.He behaves up normal compared to other dogs. One day he was playing with his friend Monki and he falinted .His owner took him to the hospital .He cried when he found out that his dog is sick and his illness is caused by the food that he gives him everyday .Jabu changed started giving Rex healthy food and he gradually recovered .He became a healthy dog.

books.title: Bella's Big Adventure
books.summary: This story is about a girl named Bella. One day her friends Daisy and Lily visited her and then realized that she was hungry. Daisy then came with an idea of going to this big tree with a lot of flies. They then asked her mother Evelyn to go there. Evelyn did not agree because she was scared that they were going to be eaten by wild animals since she could not accompany then because she was injured. Lily told her friends to go without her permission, they then left and when they arrived at the big tree they stored a lot of flies in the leaves and then left. On their way to home they came across the snake that wanted to eat them but fortunately they managed to run away. When they arrived home with the flies they told Evelyn the truth. She shouted them and told them to never do that again. From that day, they started to listen to elders.

books.title: Roxy, the miracle dog
books.summary: This story tells a beautiful tale of a dog named Roxy that helped to heal her bestfriend when she was very sick. It was a miracle that a dog could do this and it was known by everyone in the village so they named Roxy the Miracle.

books.title: The Little Farmhouse
books.summary: In a small village in the south, Mrs. Helen owned a cozy farmhouse with her three little livestock: Ms. Hen, Mr. Sheep, and Ms. Cow. Ms. Hen, a beautiful brown and white feathered chicken, felt lonely and decided to go on a hunger strike to protest Mrs. Helen's removal of her eggs and milk. Despite her discomfort, Mr. Sheep and Ms. Cow realized that Mrs. Helen also depended on the products they provided. They sang their daily song, "It's a little farm alright, in a little farm we share," and advised Ms. Hen to talk to Mrs. Helen and ask for a compromise. Mrs. Helen agreed to leave three eggs every time Ms. Hen laid eggs, allowing her to have a family.With the agreement in place, harmony returned to the little farmhouse, and the animals sang their favorite song, rejoicing together. The story highlights the importance of sharing and under

books.title: URoxy: Inja enomlingo
books.summary: Incwadi le ikhuluma ngenja ibizo layo kungu Roxy owasiza umngani wakhe omkhulu lokha nakagulako. Bekumlingo kobana inja ikwazi ukulapha umuntu, yeke wanikezwa ibizo elithi inja enomlingo.

books.title: Grannie's peaches
books.summary: Grannie's Peaches is a story about a loving and hardworking old lady who takes care of her farm and two grandchildren, Rele and Loge. When she is requested to deliver two hundred peaches to the market, she realizes she cannot count. Her grandchildren, Rele and Loge, come to help her on a Saturday morning. They sort and count the peaches together, with each girl grouping the peaches in a different way. In the end, they can deliver one hundred peaches to the market, making Granny happy.

books.title: Diperekisi tša koko
books.summary: Se mabapi le Koko wa lerato yo a bego a rata go hlokemela dienywa tša gagwe gore a kgone go rekiša kua mmarakeng, o kopana le nngangabala ya taba ka ge a swanetše go iša diperekisi tše makgolo kua mmarakeng ka de a sa kgone go bala, ka ba ka la botho le lerato la gagwe ditlogolo tša gagwe di a mo thuša ka go balela diperekisi tšeo di nyakegago.

books.title: The curious ant's adventure
books.summary: The story is about an ant who goes on an adventure to learn about other insect and animal homes

books.title: Petere Nonyana e Bohlale
books.summary: Ka letšatši le lengwe, nonyana e nngwe yeo e bitšwago Petere e be e fofa ka sethokgweng, e nyaka dijo. O ile a bona seboko se gogoba fale fase gomme a theogela fase go yo se topa. O rile a sa re o topa seboko seo gomme Katse a tšwelela, a leka go mo swara. Bjalo ka ge Katse e be e le kgauswi le go thopa Petere, Leribiši le legolo la lenaka le ile la fofela tlase la swara Katse ka mosela gomme la fofa le yona. Le ile la lahlela Katse ka bodibeng. Petere o ile a leboga kudu go Leribiši ka ge a phološitše bophelo bja gagwe. Petere o ile a ithuta dithuto tše bohlokwa go yena, a hlalefa le go ba le tsebo.

books.title: Tano and his dog, Rex..
books.summary: The story is a boy named Tano who had a dog named Rex, one day there were bored at home and decided to go the park , they went to the park and Tano made new friends and they all played all over the park.

books.title: Naa, Boati o ile kae?
books.summary: Boati o tšwa ka lebelo o leba ka nokeng go lata mahlakanoka a go dira lešaka..kanegelo ye e bolela ka Boati,mosetsana yoo mmagwe a ilego a mo roma nokeng go ya go lata mahlakanoka ago direla dipudi moo dika dulago, Boati o ile aya nokeng a lata mahlakanoka o rile ale tseleng ya go bowa a kopana le nonyana ya mebalabela e botse a dula fase a bolela le nonyana yeo, o ile a dula le nonyana nako a telele , morago o ile a gopola gore o romilwe gomme a leba gae ,o ile a humana mmagwe a swabile ka ge ebe lele kgale a letile mahlakanoka.

books.title: PRINCESS AND HER SISTER TRIP TO SONGIMVELO
books.summary: This story is about two sisters who went on a trip at Songimvelo nature reserve where they saw animals. They went to Kromdraai camp later. The next day they went to Graskop having fun to see the beautiful creatures of the nature in Mpumalanga.

books.title: Isifiso sika Mlondi
books.summary: indatjana le imayelana nomsanyana omncani uMlondi onesifiso sokuya edorobheni ngebhesi akhambe nonina,

books.title: THE MYSTERIOUS FARM
books.summary: this story is based on a farmer called Mr. Boggies the farmer had different types of livestock in his farm the problem was that every morning the farmer finds his livestock missing in the beginning he thought it was a magic happening but at last he find out who was stealing for him

books.title: Insimu Yetimanga
books.summary: kulendzaba ikhuluma ngemlimi lobekanemfuyo lenyenti ensimini yakhe lomnumzane njalo nakavuka ekuseni utfola imfuyo yakhe inyamalele kepha lomlimi bekacabanga kutsi kwenteke imlingo lapha ensimini yakhe loko bekutiphindza phindza mihla yonkhe nemalanga kwaze kwafika lapho lomnumzane naye wafisa kutsi abone lesimanga lesentekako lapha ensimini yakhe lomlimi watfola kutsi kute umlingo lowentekeko njengoba yena bekacabanga kepha watfola kutsi ngu Boggies loyo bekeba imfuyo yakhe wabona kutsi kuncono achamuke nelicebo kutsi abambe lesigebengu lesimhlupha kangaka

books.title: The clever frogs
books.summary: The story is about three families of frogs, the mother of the little frogs kept on losing their little frogs. So they came up with a plan which will help the little frogs not to be lost again. They taught them about the different colors at their backs which they should use to check each other when going back home after playing.

books.title: The farmer and the trees save the day
books.summary: The narrative centers on a farmer who shared his farm with a dog, a cow, and a goat. The farmer gave the dog too much trust and constantly instructed it on what to do while he was away. In addition, the farmer left the farm and left the dog with instructions because the goat and the cow had a reputation for disobeying rules. The other animals ignored the dog's commands and demolished the farm while the farmer was visiting his uncles. The dog had to go get the farmer as the issues grew, and it did so by following his scent. After being informed of the situation, the farmer had to depart early to ensure the well-being of the farm's animals. In order to ensure that the animals had food and protection from the sun, the farmer also arrived at the farm and relocated the animals to a new section. He thanked the trees for their protection.

books.title: My family and pets.
books.summary: The story is about my family, my pets and the weather.

books.title: Go Abelana Legapu
books.summary: Kanegelo ye e mabapi le bagwera ba bararo, Lebo, Tumi le Sonti, bao ba yago pikiniki gomme ba lebeletšana le tlhohlo ya go abelana legapu ka go lekana. Ba šomiša dikgopolo tša dipalo tša go swana le dihalofo, boraro le dikotara go arola legapu ka toka. Ka go šoma ka sehlopha le go rarolla mathata, ba ithuta bohlokwa bja go abelana le go šoma mmogo. Mafelelong, ba thabela pikiniki ya bona, ba leboga thuto yeo ba ithutilego yona le tlemo ya bona e tiilego ya segwera.

books.title: Naledi's skipping rope
books.summary: Naledi Skipping Rope is a tale about a girl named Naledi who, despite being alone at first, finds companionship when her neighbors join her in playing skipping rope. As they play together, they form a bond of friendship. However, when one of their friends gets hurt and another becomes hungry, they decide to part ways. Before doing so, they make a promise to remain friends. The story highlights the power of friendship and the joy of simple pleasures.

books.title: The three little fire starters.
books.summary: Once upon a time, on a Saturday morning in a township in Burgersfort, a mother left her three children and went to town. The kids got hungry, so one of them had the idea to cook something. Unfortunately, there was no electricity. They made a fire inside the house, which ended badly because the kitchen caught fire. They managed to escape and called for help. When their mother returned, she found people in her yard, and she was in tears. Firefighters were also there amongst those people. She promised to never leave her kids alone again.

books.title: umuthi wobungani
books.summary: kwakusekuseni ilanga libalele ngethwasahlobo lokha umntazinyana ongu Londeka azikhambela nakazakubona umuzi kabamkhulu uMgidi unomuthi obonakala udanile begodu unganakekelwa.wangena wakokoda watjela ubamkhulu bona ubone lomuthi begodu ufisa ukumrhelebha bona babuyise ipilo kiwo.ubamkhulu wavuma.bathoma lapho batjala umuthana eqadi kwaloya omdala ngethemba lokobana uzokuvuka.nangambala umuthi wavuka,bathaba khulu nabomakhelwana beza bazokuthaba bebagidinge nabo.

books.title: The seed of friendship
books.summary: the story is about a little boy called Londi and an old man called Mr. Mgidi, they plant a young sampling symbolling their friendship. They nurture the tree, and their bond deepens, the tree grows to show signs of revival. Neighbours come together to celebrate the tree transformation with Londi and Mr. Mgidi.In a quiet neighborhood, a young Londi notices the old tree in Mr. Mgidi's garden looking sad and neglected. concerned, he offers help to help him revive his garden.

books.title: Mbuti, Inja kanye naNkhomo
books.summary: Lendzaba imayelana netilwane letintsatfu emagama ato ngu Inja, Mbuti kanye naNkhomo. Letilwane letintsatfu bekubangani labakhulu kakhulu, bahlalanjalo bandzawonye. Kwatsi ngalelinye lemalanga babaneluhambo ngetekisi.

books.title: Cow, Dog and Goat
books.summary: The story is about a group of animals who went on trip using a taxi.

books.title: Alex Magical Garden Adventure
books.summary: Alex, a curious boy, discovers a magical stick in his backyard garden that transports him to the miniature world of insects. In this world, he meets three friends: Bee, Spider, and Ant. Together, they embark on a journey to find food, with each insect using their unique abilities to contribute. However, Bee gets carried away and flies off without informing the others, leading to him losing track of his friends. Alex, upon arriving in the miniature world, offers to help Bee find his lost companions. They follow Spider's webs and eventually find themselves caught in them, only to be rescued by Spider himself. Spider then informs them that Ant is missing in a dark tunnel. With Alex's help and the aid of the magical stick, they locate Ant and reunite with him. The story ends with laughter and relief as they make their way out of the tunnel.

books.title: IKHAMBO LAMI NGESIBONIBONI
books.summary: umsanyana obizwa ngoThulani ogade athanda iinlwanyana ezincani afuna ukufunda ngazo bona ziphila bunjani. Ngelinye ilanga wathola isiboniboni ngetonini yakwabo samthumela lapho bekafisa ukuyakhona walithabela khulu ikhambo lakhe lesiboniboni.

books.title: Usenathi nengadze yakhe lenhle
books.summary: Kadzeni bekunemfana longi Usenathi, bekahlala nemdeni wakhe kanye na dzadze wakhe. Usenathi bekangumfana lotsandza ingadze.Ngalelinye linanga wacela batali bakhe kutsi ucela kuhlanyela egcekeni. Babe wabo wabatsengela inhlanyelo, bahlanyela.Tatsi tikhula tibhidvo, kwachamuka sigebengu satjontja tibhidvo engadzini. Batali ba Usenathi baphuma endlini ngekushesha bajahe lesigebengu. Sadla phasi. Bafonela maphoyisa abuya asibamba, basifaka ejele.

books.title: Emacandza labiwe
books.summary: Endzaweni lencane, Mkhulu, umfuyi wetinkhukhu, watfola kutsi emacandza akhe ayanyamalala. Mkhulu wacala kusola Sibusiso, umfana lobekanetinkinga, wabese uyambamba. Sibusiso wavuma kutsi ulambile. Esikhundleni sekumjezisa, Mkhulu wamniketa kudla kanye nemsebenti wekunakekela tinkhukhu. Sibusiso wafundza kubaluleka kwekucela lusito kunekuba. Ngemoya lomuhle nangeseluleko sakhe, Mkhulu wafundzisa Sibusiso sifundvo lesibalulekile, wakhulisa similo sekwetsembana nekuvana emmangweni wakubo.

books.title: Usenathi with his beautiful garden
books.summary: Usenathi and his family, living in the village of Kamachekeza, decide to turn their lawn into a garden. Their father, overhearing their wish, surprises them by bringing home plants and flowers for their new garden. Grateful for their father's thoughtfulness, Usenathi and his sister express their thanks. The family eagerly begins gardening the next morning, but encounters weeds in their fields. Later, they face a thief attempting to steal from their garden, but with quick action, they catch the thief and retrieve their vegetables. Through teamwork and perseverance, Usenathi's family transforms their lawn into a beautiful and productive garden, overcoming challenges along the way

books.title: Segwera sea hlokomelwa
books.summary: Kanegelwana ye e ka mogwera yo a ratago bagwera ba gagwe kudu. Go direga gore yo mongwe a bolele se se sa kgahlego ka bona gomme yena a eme ka dinao go ba emelelela.

books.title: Gifts from farm animals
books.summary: The story is about four farm animals that live together. It begins when bee starts to talk about how special they are as animals then the cow ends up laughing. The cow goes on to boasts about how more of a special animal she is resulting in making other animals feel little and less special.

books.title: Njabulo's healthy adventure.
books.summary: This book is about a little boy who is very energetic and likes playing outdoors. one day his mother realizes that his energy levels are dropping slowly. thus, leading him to a healthy lifestyle.

books.title: UGWEZI
books.summary: ISITORI SIMAYELANA NOMNTWANA OBIZWA BONA NGU GWEZI, UGWEZI UMNTWANA ONGALALELIKO. LOKHA UGOGWAKHE NAKAGWALAKO UGWEZI SIMTHOLA UKHWELA ISIHLAHLA UKHA AMAGWAVA. UGWEZI UHLANGABEZANA NENLWAYANA WAZIGIJIMISA NGOKUNJALO WALAHLEKA, UBABU NGWENYA NGUYE ORHELEBHE UGWEZI BONA AKGHONE UKUBUYELA EKHABO.

books.title: Sipho Umfana longanaki
books.summary: Sipho umfana longanaki lotsandza kudlala ngemanti

books.title: sipho the careless boy
books.summary: the story is about Sipho a careless boy who likes wasting water, every chance he gets he wastes water. his mother noticed that he likes wasting water. his mother took Sipho to the beach, and Sipho wanted to have fun. he wasted all the water in the bottle. after some time he gets thirsty and cries. his mother saw Sipho crying, so she approached Sipho and asked him why is he crying. Sipho replied "My water is finished and am thirsty" his mother took her water bottle and gave him a drink. " Do you see the important of wasting water? ask his mother. Sipho nodded his head. we drink water, we use water to cook and bath. all the living things on earth need water to survive, so you must stop wasting water. from that day Sipho started saving water.

books.title: Matome o nyakišiša ka ga magae a diphoofolo.
books.summary: Go "Matome o nyakišiša ka Magae a Diphoofolo", mošemane yo a nago le kgahlego yo a bitšwago Matome o thoma leeto la go ithuta ka magae goba madulo a diphoofolo tše di fapa-fapanego le dibopiwa tša tlhago. Ge a le tseleng, o gahlana le dinonyana tšeo di agago dihlaga, dinose ka diphagong tša tšona, ditšhošwane ka magaeng a tšona tša ka fase ga mobu, ditšhwene mehlareng, dinoga ka mekoting, dihlora ka dihlageng tša ka godimo ga mehlare le kgopa le khudu yeo e rwelego magae a tšona mokokotlong. Ka go kopana le diphoofolo tše, Matome o hwetša tebogo e mpsha bakeng sa ditsela tše di sa tlwaelegago le tše di kgethegilego tšeo ka tšona diphoofolo di bopago, di hwetšago le go rwala magae a tšona. Kanegelo ye e ruthetšago pelo e gatelela botse le mehuta-huta ya lefase la tlhago, e tutuetša babadi go hlompha le go kgahlwa ke legae la diphoofolo.

books.title: GO TLHOMAMISA GA WHISKER LE ROVER.
books.summary: Kanegelo e latela ditiragalo tša go makatša tša katse yeo e bitšwago Whisker le mpša yeo e bitšwago Rover, bao ba dulago ka lethabo le mong wa bona yo botho, Mohumagadi Johnson, ka ntlong e kgahlišago ya ka ntle ga toropo yeo e nago le jarata e kgolo ya ka morago. Ka letšatši le lengwe la letšatši, ge ba dutše ba bapala ka jarateng, ba kopana le mpšanyana ya moagišani wa bona yeo e timetšego le yeo e tšhogilego, Sparky, yeo e lelera kgole kudu le gae. Whisker le Rover ba tšea sephetho sa go thuša Sparky ka go mo hlahla morago ntlong ya Mohumagadi Johnson, moo ba nyakago thušo ya go ikgokaganya le mong wa Sparky. Mohumagadi Johnson o fihlelela mong wa Sparky ka pela, yo a tlago go tšea mpšanyana yeo e timetšego, ka go rialo a kopanya Sparky le lapa la gagwe gape. Ka botho bja bona le go šoma ka sehlopha, Whisker, Rover le MohumagadiJohnson

books.title: Katse ya mamoratwa
books.summary: Go bolela ka mosadi Mokgadi o a dulago motsaneng wa Gamphahlele, mosadi yo o hloka thari gomme o ile a ikgothatsa ka katse ya mamoratwa ka ge a dula le yona feela ebile e mohola ka go bolaya magotlo. Go ile gwa direga gore katse ya mamoratwa e timele gomme Mokgadi o ile a kwa bohloko kudu a holofela gore etla boa gomme gwa pala. Mosadi yo o ile a bona ele bo kaone gore aye go reka katse e nngwe.

books.title: Kubera Iki Nsinzira?
books.summary: Umwana agiye kutubwira akamaro ko gusinzira. Hari akamaro gatandukanye ko gusinzira. Ariko abenshi ntabwo bakazi. Muri aka gakuru, murasomamo ibintu bitandukanye birimo n'akamaro ko gusnzira ku mwana no ku muntu mukuru. Buri mwana akeneye gusinzira amasaha runaka bitewe n'imyaka afite.

books.title: Bagwera ba potego.
books.summary: Matome le Lesiba ba thabela leeto la sekolo la go ya serapeng sa diphoofolo. Ge Lesiba a lebala dijo tša gagwe tša mosegare, Matome o abelana tša gagwe ka lethabo, a fetoša kotsi yeo gore e be leeto le le sa lebalegego. Ba ithuta gore segwera sa kgonthe se mabapi le go thekgana.

books.title: Thabang's wish
books.summary: the story is about a smart boy named Thabang. His wish is to travel with her mother to town using a big bus that he admires so much.

books.title: The tale of stolen eggs
books.summary: In the small village, Philly, a chicken keeper, discovered his eggs were disappearing. Suspecting Bless, a troubled boy, Philly set a trap and caught him. Bless confessed out of hunger. Instead of punishment, Philly offered food and a job caring for the chickens. Bless learned the value of asking for help rather than stealing. Through kindness and guidance, Philly taught Bless an important lesson, fostering a sense of trust and understanding in their community.

books.title: Bathomi ba bararo ba mollo.
books.summary: Mosadi yo mongwe o ile a sia bana ba bagwe bao ba nalego mengwaga ya ka tlase ga lesome ba le tee aya mabenkeleng. Bana bao ba ile ba swara ke tlala gomme ba leka go dira dijo moo ba ilego ba feleletsa ba tshuba ntlo ya mmago bona. Ka mahlatse ga gona yeo a ilego a gobala gomme borasetimamollo ba ile ba fihla.

books.title: KA Polaseng
books.summary: padi ye e ka ga polase ye nnyane yeo e bušago ke mohumagadi Helen. Yena o ruile dikgogo, Nku gammogo le dikgomo. padi ye ya rena e hlakana le mathata ge mohumagadi kgogo a thoma go tšweletša maikutlo a gagwe mabapi le taba ya gore yo mohumagadi Helen o mo tšeela mae a gagwe ntle le go mofa se kgoba sa gore a be le bana leye. mola bagwera ba gagwe nku le kgomo baile ba mmotša ka fao bona ba lebogelang maitshwenyo a mohumagadi Helen ka ge a ba rola merwalo. boraro bo ile ba kwana gore bokaone ke gore yo mohumagadi Kgogo a boledišane le mohumagadi Helen gomme ba fihlelele kwano magareng ga bona. bobedi bo ile ba kwana gomme khutšo ya boela ka lapeng la diruiwa le mong polase.

books.title: Letšatši la go ralokela puleng
books.summary: E be e le mesong moo mosetsana yo a bitšwago Mimi a ile a tsoga ale bodutwaneng. O ile a bona maru a thibile gomme a apara diaparo tša gage a yo raloka puleng.

books.title: The hot summer
books.summary: This is a story about two siblings (Biggy and Bony) and their dog, Furry. Furry is a friendly dog who enjoys being around Biggy and Bony.They loved each other so deeply that they didn't want the other to be sad. They also enjoyed playing in the water sprinkles during the hot summer days. They decided to play a ball game one day, but Bony kept missing the ball, which made her sad. Biggy disliked seeing her sister upset, so he suggested that they have ice cream instead to make Bony smile again.

books.title: SEMAKA SA DINAMELWA TšA GOšIAšIANA!
books.summary: Toropong ya Mabitsi, go ile gwa ba le mogwanto wa ngwaga le ngwaga wa Dinamelwa tša gošiašiana di tlala mebileng ka mebala le lethabo. Bere le bagwera ba gagwe, Sehlora, Mmutla, le Katse, ba tletše ka lethabo go tšea karolo. Yo mongwe le yo mongwe o na le mokgwa wa moswananoši wa dinamelwa: Mutla ka sethuthuthu sa lebelo, Sehlora ka balune ya moya o fišago le Katse ka lepara la maletlana la lefsielo. Ge mogwanto o thoma, ba kopana le ditlhohlo tšeo di hlohleleditšwego ke mekgwa e fapa-fapanego ya dinamelwa. Go sa lebeletšwe mapheko, ba šoma gotee, ba ithuta ka go šoma ka sehlopha le go amogela diphapano tša bona. Mafelelong, ba fihla mafelelong a magolo, ba bontšha ditalente tša bona le go keteka go fapafapana le segwera.

books.title: The naughty monkey and the brave dog
books.summary: In a village, Mr. Shaba and his children, Lili and Lihle, had a dog named Spoti and grew vegetables. One day, a naughty monkey stole their vegetables. Mr. Shaba's idea to trick the monkey with Spoti's help worked, and they got their vegetables back. The story teaches teamwork and problem-solving skills.

books.title: The daring Delphine
books.summary: Delphine, the daring Dolphine, embarked on an adventure in the deep sea, encountering Dungeness crabs in need of guidance. With bravery and kindness, Delphine led them home, earning admiration from sea creatures for his courage and compassion.

books.title: Mafahla a go sekwe
books.summary: "Mafahla a g sekwe" e ka ga masogana a mabedi ao e bego e le mafahla ba bitšwago Katlego le Keatlegile. Ba be ba dula le tatago bona Malose gomme ka tšatši le lengwe o ile aba roma go išetša makgolo wa bona dipanana gomme aba laela gore ba seke ba tšeya tsela ya sethokgwa. Ka bobodu ba ile ba tšea tsela yeo gomme ka madimabe ba palelwa kego fihla ga makgolo wa bona. Go tloga tšatši leo ga sanka ba ba dumela gotšwa ka kgoro ntle le ge ba eya sekolong.

books.title: Busi and Nana's baking adventure
books.summary: In a cosy town, a little girl named Busi, and her grandmother Nana embark on a baking adventure after being inspired by the delicious cookies from the local bakery. Despite their initial attempt resulting in disappointment due to lack of precise measurements, they seek help from the friendly baker, Buddy. With Buddy's guidance, they learn the importance of accurate measurements in baking and successfully create a batch of cookies even better than the bakery's. Through this experience, Busi learns that some adventures are sweeter when shared with loved ones.

books.title: Hazel's Counting at the Park
books.summary: Hazel, a curious child, joins Mr. Brown, a friendly park ranger, on an adventure of counting! They explore the park together, counting colorful flowers, swings on the playground, and even friendly squirrels. Through this playful learning experience, Hazel discovers the importance of numbers and how they help us compare and explore the world around us.

books.title: The New Baby
books.summary: An introduction to the new baby and discover who the baby is to the writer.

books.title: The fruit thief
books.summary: The story is about a homeless boy who survives by stealing fruits at night. He was caught and gained a home.

books.title: Bopie and her best friend
books.summary: In a small town, Bopie found a scared and hungry white-pinkish kitten named Snowball. She named her and made her a best friend. One day, Bopie and Snowball saved a rabbit from being chased by dogs in a thicket. Bopie's barking and Snowball's bravery led the dogs to stop, and the rabbit was safely saved. Bopie and Snowball became heroes in their town, and their friendship grew. They had many more adventures together, learning that even small acts of kindness can make a big difference. Snowball proved to be a loyal and courageous companion, making them the perfect team.

books.title: Vusi ufundza inhlonipho
books.summary: Vusi bekangumfana lohlala nagogo wakhe emakhaya. Batali bakhe bamshiya amncane bayofuna umsebenti eJozi. Loku kwamhlukubeta emoyeni Vusi.Lomfana bekangamlaleli kugogo ngobe atsembe kutsi akanabatali. Kwatsi ngalelinye lilanga bavumbuka batali bakhe babukeka bacebile kodvwa bangakhombisi kumnaka Vusi. Kulapho Vusi wabona khona kutsi kugogo wakhe nguye kuphela lamtsandzako.

books.title: Busi nagogo wakhe babhaka emakokisi
books.summary: Kulendzatjana sitfola Busi, intfombatanyane leneminyaka lesikhombisa. Busi uhlala nagogo wakhe. Gogo waBusi uhlala abhaka emakokisi lamnandzi, ngenca yaloko, Busi ugcine afundza kubhaka makokisi lamnandzi

books.title: Ukot, ubọk mè ibot!
books.summary: Kween̄ inu ofolek nriro inọ-lek go cha mè ike akpalek mè nden̄ ebilene okupbe uyeke uyeke.

books.title: Max the caterpillar and the kind ladybug
books.summary: In a forest, a lonely caterpillar named Max sought a friend. He found a beautiful ladybug and they explored together. As the sun set, the ladybug flew away, but Max transformed into a beautiful butterfly. The ladybug cheered him on and encouraged him to fly. Max flew into the sky, feeling free and happy. The ladybug watched him go, knowing they would always be friends. From then on, Max the butterfly continued to explore the forest, making new friends and having many adventures.

books.title: Selemo le makokokoko a sona
books.summary: Puku ye e mabapi le bašemane ba ba bedi elego Tiso le Luti. Bobedi bjo bo be bo rata selemo. Bobedi bjo bo be o nyemetše go re selemo se goroge. Se rile ge se fihla selemo, Luti le Tiso ba ile ba thaba la go makatša, ba palela ke go iswara, gomme ba tšwa ba ya go bogela di naledi. Ba rile ba sa dutše ba bogetše di naledi gwa fihla monang, wa ba hloriša. Luti le Tiso ba ile ba loga leano la monang owe, gomme ba feletša ba fentše ka go šumiša kgotlelelo

books.title: Creating Simple Sentences
books.summary: Simple SentencesIn technical terms, there are two forms of simple, present tense, positive sentences. To illustrate this, let's look at two sentences:1. Monna o reka nama = The man is buying meat2. Monna o a reka = The man is buyingWhat is the difference between the two? Both have the noun, concord and verb like the sentences above. The difference is that in sentence #1 there is an object noun (nama) after the verb. In sentence #2 the verb is the last word.In Setswana when a sentence ends with a verb you must put the letter a directly in front of the verb, to prop it up. The A is called the present tense A.When a sentence has an object, the present tense A falls away.Subject Noun + Concord + Verb + Object NounHowever if you do not have an object noun after the verb, thus you say:Subject noun + concord + a + verb

books.title: Tenses
books.summary: In Tswana, when your sentence is in the present tense, you will use what we call the present tense "a".The "a" indicates the present tense.When another word follows on the verb, the "a" is left out.The Future tense indicates that an action will take place in the future.The Future tense form "tla" is used to indicate future actions.It can also be said that the future tense form "tla" replaces the present tense "a".Past Tense indicates that an action was not yet completed at the time of observation (in the past). A sentence in this tense consists of: Subject (noun) + subject concord + ne + subject concord + verb.

books.title: La nube de arcoíris
books.summary: La historia de Laura y Paula. La gemela que debe ser sacrificada, Laura se enfrenta a un bully y a fantasmas espantosos ¿Será que el lazo con su hermana Paula la salvará?

books.title: La tierra sin gente vieja
books.summary: Este cuento siniestro proveniente de la gente de Nuquí en Choco, nos recuerda la importancia de tener gente vieja en nuestras comunidades.

books.title: ¡Cuídate en la playa!
books.summary: Hay corrientes peligrosas en algunas playas. Se llaman corrientes de resaca y pueden alejar a una persona de la playa muy rápido. Por esto debes nadar en una playa que tiene salvavidas y nadar dentro de la zona delimitada. (Esta historia fue escrita y publicada por el National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), usando el African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: ¡A comer todos los colores!
books.summary: Las frutas y los vegetales son buenos para nosotros, pero ¿cuál es la diferencia entre una fruta y un vegetal?

books.title: Bebés arrebatados por la cigüeña
books.summary: Un grupo de cigüeñas ven a un bebé llorando y deciden llevárselo.

books.title: El hombre que construyó su propia casa
books.summary: Esta es la historia de un hombre que construye buenas casas para la gente de su pueblo, pero él duerme en una mala casa.

books.title: ¿Hay alguien como yo?
books.summary: Yo me pregunto si hay alguien como yo en alguna parte del mundo.

books.title: Yo amos los bosques
books.summary: En el bosque de Kibale conoceremos diferentes especies de pájaros, animales y plantas.

books.title: Mi familia y yo
books.summary: ¡Una historia de las aventuras de un pequeño niño y una familia muy inusual!

books.title: Animales de granja
books.summary: Ilustraciones para acompañar los nombres de algunos animales familiares.

books.title: Una casa para un ratón
books.summary: Un ratón visita varios lugares hasta que encuentra el lugar perfecto para dormir.

books.title: Siswati Greetings L1
books.summary: Greeting is a very important action in the African culture. It is also important to enquire on the person's wellbeing by asking how he/she is doing. It is also an indication of respect.

books.title: ¿Cuántos?
books.summary: Cuenta cuántos insectos, animales y pájaros puedes ver en cada imagen.

books.title: Fana ama los animales
books.summary: Fana pasa su tiempo con los animales, alimentándolos y jugando con ellos.

books.title: Mi madre
books.summary: La historia del amor de mi madre hacía mí, su único hijo. Ella me ama mucho y yo la amo a ella.

books.title: Matšatši A Beke Le Dinomoro
books.summary: Go bala matšatši a beke le go tseba go bala dinomoro. Go tšeba Matšatši le go bala dinomoro go thuša ba badi le ba ba ithutang.

books.title: TSEBA
books.summary: TSEBA ke puku ye e rutang bana go tsebe mabitšo a bona ka botlalo le mo ba dulago gona. E tlaba ruta go tseba mengwaga le sekolo mo baithutago gona.

books.title: Personal concords
books.summary: Emphatic or absolute pronouns. Nna, Wena, Rona, Lona, Yena and Bona are never used in the place of personal concords. They a used to emphasices a specifx personeel.

books.title: ¡Lávate las manos!
books.summary: Hay muchos gérmenes que no vemos con nuestros ojos, pero causan enfermedades. Lavarse las manos con agua y jabón, por veinte segundos, puede parar la difusión de gérmenes que causan enfermedades.

books.title: Me siento preocupado
books.summary: ¿Cómo manejas tus miedos y preocupaciones durante la pandemia del coronavirus?

books.title: ¡Fuego, otra vez!
books.summary: Mostramos diferentes usos del fuego, pero recordamos que el fuego puede ser peligroso y destructivo.

books.title: ¿Podemos contar nuestros gatos?

Ha sido creado originariamente en un workshop de desarrollo de historia por 22 educadores en Febrero 2019, con la asociación de British Council y el Departamento de Educación básica (Sudáfrica).
