books.summary: Embozi eno egema kukulambura na abaana ku ebyo byebayinza okukola singa baali ekyo.

books.title: Mazima ni Kaasiisa
books.summary: Empndhiika eyamadandha ku mukwano n'okufunha mu okuva mubulo.

books.title: Omupiira gwange ogwa kasaayi
books.summary: Omupiira gwa kasaayi omubba guja mu lugendo.

books.title: Omuluvu
books.summary: Kibonerezo ki eky'omulenzi omuluvu eyalya ebibala ebingi?

books.title: Wampube omubba
books.summary: Wampube ow'omunsiko acaalira Wampube w'omunhumba okubona obulamu obwewunhisa munda omwo. Aye obuluvu bwa Wampubi, bwayegeresa Wampube ow'omunsiko okwisa ekitiisa mu maka gaayo.

books.title: Ologhoozye
books.summary: Olufumo luno lukwatagana na kukulankulania ndoghoozya y'obukodyo mu baana.

books.title: Omwana eyalira
books.summary: Olufumo olutali lwa bibono nga lugema kukulabirira akaana.

books.title: Mwami Nsoghera ni mwami Kyamutwe
books.summary: Mwami Nsoghera ni mwami Kyamutwe bali bamukwano. Lulala baghakana nti naani aghanga okusala omwiga. Enkomerero tiyali nkalamu.

books.title: Omukaire mu'Thupa
books.summary: Omukazi omukaire omuluvu eyali aba yenka yesinwa okuba mu'thupa. Lulala, omuzirakisa yamucaaliraku. Wetegereze ebyamutukaku!

books.title: Ekibwala
books.summary: Omwisuka ayagaana era aleega ekibwala. Agha ekinhonhi ekifu omusaadha omukaire ku kyalo, afumba era alya ebibwala.

books.title: Katintu Mumambo, akaghala akagezi
books.summary: Katintu Mumambo akozesa amagezi ge okwewonhia ni baganda be ku gusota ogunene. Aye oluvainhuma bagandabe bamwabulira mu nsulo era endhovu yaamumira. Katiitu aneewonhia atya?

books.title: Nze ni bake bange
books.summary: Luno lufumo lwa baana era ne bintu bye batera okwagaana.

books.title: Embiidhi ti dhiikirizibwa ghano
books.summary: Olufumo luno lwinhongola lwaki embiidhi dhiba n'enhindo emambaatavu. Kiki ekindi olufumo luno kyerutwegesa?

books.title: Akabwa akato
books.summary: Olufumo lwa wa kabwa n'akapuusi nga buzaanha n'omupiira.

books.title: Matyansi Omuluvu
books.summary: Mayansi omuluvu agezaaku okubuzaabuza bakagwa be okumuwa ebighula ku mugabo gwe ogwe emitiini aye baine bakitereera.

books.title: Otasonsonhia katonda
books.summary: Waira eyareba katonda tiyamaliriza kudhuba nhimiro ye.

books.title: Musa ni laata we
books.summary: Laata gha Musa nga atamiira buli bwire. Mubwire bulala, yalumbibwa empiti. Ghaligho ayinza okuba nga akamuyamba nga ate abaire abakola obukodyo buli kasera?

books.title: Obuzito n'obugheghere
books.summary: Mulugero luno tukobebwa okukola kuki ekizito nekigheghere.

books.title: Omukazi omuluvu (Colour-in)
books.summary: Ghobanga endhala, kirungi okuba ow'amazima okusinga okwiba.

books.title: Ebigema ku Wante oghekyewunio
books.summary: Emboozi yabaana bato nga egema kunte eboneka omusana nga ekyo okuzaanhisa ekigonvu, ayenga obulaamu bwayo obwire ya"kyeghunio" erwanagana ne emisango era yaghonia abantu.

books.title: Nakanda Omusagambu
books.summary: Omughala eyafuna engaito omukuzi gwe ogusooka mu bulamu bwe.

books.title: Omugaso gw'emiti
books.summary: Olughayo luli ku mugaso gwo omuti mu bulamu bwaife obwbulidho.

books.title: Engoye dh'eisomero
books.summary: Ndhikwirayo ku isomero era ndi nokwegezaamu engoye dhange dhoonadhoona mbone oba dhintuuka.

books.title: Ekibonerezo
books.summary: Kibonerezo ki ekigheebwa omulenzi eyalya ebibala ebingi? SINIINI BATAAMYE OMUVUNUZI.

books.title: Omuliro gwizeemu
books.summary: Tufuuna emirimo mingi inho egy'omuliro, aye mukimane nga omuliro gusobola okuba ogw'akabendhe era oguzikiriza.

books.title: Omukeeka gwa Akaali
books.summary: Ono omuguna omusoga akula no omukeeka ogutagaanika.

books.title: Okucaalira dhaadha omukazi
books.summary: Abaana babiri beesunga era bacamuka nga bateekateeka okucaalira dhaadha ghaibwe. Banhumirwa obulamu mukyaalo era tibaduuba kuvaayo.

books.title: Ebbaluwa ya'maama
books.summary: Maama aja mwidwaliro kuzala mughalaghe yamughandiikira e'bbaluwa.

books.title: Kitakataka
books.summary: Ekitabo kino kirimu okwinhonhola ebifaananhie eby'ebintu ebyendaghulo ebya kitakataka.

books.title: Nakiranda ku isomero
books.summary: Olufumo luno olunhuma lusikiriza era luwaga abazaire era na abana abasubira okutandiika eisomero.

books.title: Jaaka omunhiivu
books.summary: Wakaima awonia Jaaka okuva mu buzibu. Aye mu kifo ekya Jaaka okusasula wakaima, acuusa endowoozaye.

books.title: Inhe masimu
books.summary: Inhe masimu muzaanhi! Osobola okufumimtiriza ku kyo okuba na amasimu ataanu, nga ga kughulizagania na bantu bandhawulo?

books.title: Dhaadha ghange omukazi
books.summary: Omulenzi acaalira dhaadha ghe omukazi era yaafuna eisanhu.

books.title: Ekiwuumulo ni dhaadha omukazi
books.summary: Abaana basanhufu nga beetegekera okuja okukyalira dhaadha ghaibwe mu kyalo.

books.title: Wankudu ni Wampiti
books.summary: Engeri Wankudu yeyafunamu ebikalakampa, ni Wampiti yeyafunamu ebibalabala ku mugongo gwe.

books.title: Isimu lya Maama
books.summary: Eno ne embozi egema ku mughala ne isimu lya maama we.

books.title: Wampologoma eyayenda omukwano (Colour-in)
books.summary: Wampologoma ayenda okuba n'omukwano n'omuntu. Baaghanga okuba mu mirembe katono, aye tigwamala kiseera. Olufumo luno lutwegeresa okuonda emikwano n'amagezi.

books.title: Ensigo Entono
books.summary: Mu byalo ebiri ku gusozi gwa Kenya, ghaaligho omuguna mulala eyakolanga einho ni maamaghe. Omuguna ono yali mwainamivu inho olw'okubona agabira agabba nga gabuzeegho aye yali mugumu olw'amaani g'ensigo entono.

books.title: Maama acuuka
books.summary: Engeri omuntu bwakula ate na'cuuka mu buli mbeera.

books.title: Palesa ayenda ebimera
books.summary: Perina mughala muto ayenda inho ebimera.

books.title: Abaisuka ababiri abayala
books.summary: Luno lufumo lwa kubala. Balirira keeki imeka Ben ni Tabo dhe baatwala era imeka dhebaalekerawo Glany.

books.title: Omusaadha yazimba endhu ye
books.summary: Emboozi egema ku musaadha eyazimba amayumba amalungi eri abe kyalo ate nga yali asula mu kayumba kabi.

books.title: Omwandhu
books.summary: Olugero olwo omusadha omuto n'egi erungi, eryamughebwa daada ghe. Omusadha omuto timulungi inho okulabirira egi lino, aye ekirungi ghamukisa.

books.title: Ekikere kyasunire kitya olususu lwakyo
books.summary: Omukugu ono ainyonyola lwaki ebikere birina emigongo emifuduki era bisobola okubba aghabula maizi.

books.title: Engaito empyaka
books.summary: Dhikusooka aja mu kibuga ni mwanina era mwanina ya mugulira engaito empyaka.

books.title: Ono ninze
books.summary: Soma ebingemaku: Kiki kyendi. Kiki kyengonza era kiki kye mpanga okukola. Ate kabiri ighe?

books.title: Omubiri
books.summary: Yega ebitundu eby'omubiri n'obuyambi nabomukwano abategereka.

books.title: Akatabo kange akebifanaanie
books.summary: Akatabo kano kalimu ebigambo ebyangu ne befanaanie.

books.title: Enzige
books.summary: Enzige dhizinda ekyalo dhaalya buli kimera. Fumintiriza ku kyalo kye kyakola?

books.title: Engeri eikere yerifuna oluwu
books.summary: Ekyafaayo kino kitunhonhola lwaki ebikere birina emigongo mikakanavu era nga biyinza no butaaba mu maadhi.

books.title: Ira einhuma, puusi
books.summary: Pusi enkalabakalaba egwa mubuzibu nga ekiseera ku lambaala kikaali.

books.title: Okukoba gheekaza
books.summary: Olufumo olugema ku bifa ku bisolo, era n'empisa dh'abantu.

books.title: Nhumirwa okukola
books.summary: Busentesi obwangu obumpi obugema ku bintu omwana byanhumirwa okukola.

books.title: Ekitambaalo ky'emisambwa
books.summary: Abafumbo baalemererwa ofuna omwana omukazi yaasuubiza okugha emisambwa ekisinga bulungi singa gimufunisa amabunda.

books.title: Olunaku Oluzibu
books.summary: Embozi eyo bulambuuzi esanhusa erimu abavubuka ababiri abawuuyizibwa.

books.title: Mudhoola omukombe omukumpania
books.summary: Omuntu akungula ekyo mwine kyaba nga yasiga!

books.title: Mbwali mubitirivu!
books.summary: Emboozi eno edhuba eti engeri bwe twiza einhuma abaana, twena twetaga okubaghana weba kola obulungi.

books.title: Mbiizi oyab'eika
books.summary: Ombiizi ataka kutwala mukisa gw'obugabirizi bwomwinaye aye tetuuka ghala!

books.title: Tuje
books.summary: Dhisentensi edigema ku bintu byetubitamu nga tuwunhiza, tukomba ku bintu, tubona era n'okugema ku bintu.

books.title: Okubala
books.summary: Mu nsiko ku kidiba tubala ebisolo ebiidha okunwa. Ologhooza kiki ekibagho nga empologoma eidye okunwa?

books.title: Ate iwe
books.summary: Timuli nakufaanana me mube baamukwano. Abaana abatafaananiraku irala baagaana ekintu kyebatabonabona, guli mukisa okubuuza, ate ighe?

books.title: Nabulira ntya mu kiya
books.summary: Omusulube bamusuubiza ogulabo ogubba ku mazaalibwa ge ago omukaaga. Nhonereza ebyaligho.

books.title: Okubala puusi
books.summary: Okubala ebiitabo, okuva kuziro okutuka ku mwenda.

books.title: Okughabulwa okucaamu
books.summary: Abasaadha babairi baghabulwa mu bucaamu omulamuzi. Banoonia okumanha okuva eri abakulu ku kyalo era oluvainhuma baba basanhufu.

books.title: Omughala gwebeeta Noola
books.summary: Noola ayenda inho doli era aba mweralalikirivu. Lwali lulala bwe yalowooza ati doli ghe, abuze.

books.title: Omulenzi eyalumuka wo
books.summary: Emboozi egemagana ku mbera mu maka nga omuntu akoze ensobi.

books.title: Baale n'omusota
books.summary: Ebintu ebibi byebikubaaku olw'okukola obulungi, buuza abantu abakulu bakuwabule.

books.title: Kiligha...?
books.summary: Yamba mikwannhogyo ebiri okuzuula ebisolo ebikweekeibwa.

books.title: Akawundhowundho kange kaligha?
books.summary: Omulenzi ali kulingalinga buli ghantu okubona akawundhowundho ke. Ana kabona?

books.title: Empologoma ni maaya
books.summary: Enpologoma enkazi yateesa okutwala abaana ba maaya.

books.title: Emboozi esanhusa
books.summary: Yagaana ensoro edhitaboneka boneka na abantu mu mboozi eno!

books.title: Ebigere,emikono no mutwe!
books.summary: Okuvumbula endowooza eitaanu ni misigha gyo mubiri no bwongo.

books.title: Tusobola okubala obupuusi?
books.summary: Kubala bitabo, okuva ku ziiro okutuuka ku mwenda.

books.title: Ngonza Bbaabba ghange
books.summary: Bbaabba ni mukagwa ghange asinga eka, awulirisa buli bwemba ndikuloodheraku ku bizibu byange.

books.title: Olufumo olw'omuliro
books.summary: Omulilo gweyogerera olufumo lwagwo. (luno luva mumutendera ogusooka mubitabo ebyenfumo kumayengo gano ag'omutimbagano ogwetebwa, "omulilo").

books.title: Totiisatiisa nga misota!
books.summary: Ab'omukwano babiri baanhiina omuti. Kye baabona kyabagha ekitangaala era baabona ekiri ku muti.

books.title: Wandogoyi
books.summary: Olufumo olw'obughangwa olwinhonhola lwaki ensebeyi tidhizaala baana.

books.title: Omuliro n'Ekidhandhaali
books.summary: Ekidhandhaali era na manda agaaka byali no kughakana ku lwe bivaamu ebireeta okufa.

books.title: Walumbe akyalira Luuka
books.summary: Luuka akola atya nga Walumbe aidha okumukyalira?

books.title: Omughala ow'amazima
books.summary: Olufumo luno lwegesa ku mugaso ogw'okwogera amazima.

books.title: Olunaku lwa Sabbiiti olwe eibbugumu
books.summary: Buli lwa sabbiiti emisana, abaana basatu baja ku mwiga okuzaana. Ghaire tibaikirizibwa kwewuga, beeyuna okwambula bainhama okweswaiga mu maadhi. Webenda okwilayo eka ate, tibabona bidhuuba bya ibwe. Baja kweinhonholaku ate batya eri inhaibwe?

books.title: Ekitono ni ekinene
books.summary: Soma ebigema ku bintu ebighanga okuba ebinene oba ebitono.

books.title: Mbbalasi
books.summary: Ebisolo ebyabulidho na maina gabyo bwe ni bwe byetebwa okwawukana ni binaabyo mu bibidha.

books.title: Kikunta
books.summary: Olufumo olugemagana ku maanhi ag'empewo.

books.title: Mukagwa gwe ntabona
books.summary: Bamukenkede babiri bakulira mu kyalo ghalala okuva mubuto bwaibwe. Owundi ava mu isomero ate nowundi aja yenka yabuula ku ku mukenkede we.

books.title: Omwana oghendhaghulo
books.summary: Olugero olutabulatabula nga lugema ku kubula, n'okubona, ensimuko ey'omuntu n'amakaage.

books.title: Nɔ Hewɔ ni Anaaa Afũ Ajao
books.summary: Ani obishi loo loofɔlɔ ji Ajao, aputupata lɛ?

books.title: Omusaadha e'yalinga yenka
books.summary: Olufumo luno lugema ku'musaadha atayendanga kulirana na'bantu baine. Omusaadha ono ni mukaziwe baja eyo mu'kayumba e'ghala ni'baine. Okweyawula okwengeri eyo kuvamu e'bizibu.

books.title: Okusalagho
books.summary: Abantu abe kyalo basalagho oku cuusa obulamu byaibwe.

books.title: Omwezi ni enkoofiira
books.summary: Omwisuka omuto afuna enkoofiira ya bbululu okuva eri maamaghe. Kikunta etwala enkoofiira ku muti omunene era omwisuka munakughavu inho. Obwire, ghabaawo avaala enkoofiira, aye omwisuka tafaayo. Anairamu yaafuna enkoofiiraye?

books.title: Puusi yange yenkikidha nayo ghaka
books.summary: Olufumo luno lugemagana ku Puusi yange eye ghaka.

books.title: Ensiri enhiiza
books.summary: Twenatwena twidhi kerere ensiri yedhikola nga dhiri kuzingaana obwiire. Akaghuka ako katonioli aye kiri kinene!

books.title: EISOMERO LYA BARAKA
books.summary: Emboozi efa ku lunaku lw'eyanhama kwisomero.

books.title: Emotoka ya Nabirye
books.summary: Nabirye ni maama ghe balikulinda motoka ebatwale ewaka. Nabirye yabona abantu bonabona abendawulo abasanhusa ne ebintu nga bwe balinda. Aye emotoka yaibwe endha?

books.title: Ente edho mukatale
books.summary: Olugo olwente lutambula mukatale, lwatabulatabula ebyobusubuzi. Omukazi mulala ye atandika okwemulugunia era yalekana. Mukwiramu, ente dhona dhiri n'okwemulugunia okwadho.

books.title: Ebyakolebwa ente ey'endhawulo
books.summary: Olufumo olw'abaana abato olugema ku nte eyagheebwa eriina erya kaadoli akagonvu, aye obwire obw'ekyama nga ente erwanhisa obwizi bw'emisango era yaaghonia abantu.

books.title: Kantono n'empiti
books.summary: Kantono mughala mulungi ate ayenda inho okuzuula byataidhi, era ayenda okwogera. Kino kimusuula mu buzibu aye kabiri kimuyamba okubuvaamu.

books.title: Oli kukola ki?
books.summary: Sentensi edhindi enhimpi edhiraga edhiraga enkozesa y'ebigambo by'ebikolwa ebya buti ebyangu.

books.title: Olunaku lwa Takia
books.summary: Omughala omusoga ono omuto akula no omukeeka gwe ogutaboneka boneka ate nga mulungi.

books.title: Kaseenhawuuzi
books.summary: Olufumo luno lugema ku kiki Kaseenhawuuzi kyakola era nibwekifuukamu ekintu eky'endhawulo.

books.title: Ekyenco
books.summary: Nonia biki bbaabba byayenda okulya munco.

books.title: Billy, Embuzi ey'ekyedhu
books.summary: Lugero ku mulenzi omuto, embuzi ye era n'engeri gya mu labiliramu waire nga wa kyedhu.

books.title: omusomesa ghange
books.summary: Omugha ono omuto agonza omusomesaghe, era ayenda okuba nga mwene.

books.title: Tamara atandiika okusoma
books.summary: Okutandiika okusoma idaala inene inho mu'bulamu bwo"mwana yenayena."

books.title: Lumuka kaduuyu lumuka
books.summary: Akaduuyu nga kalambaire ghansi woomuti gwebibala, ekibala kyagwa ghansi kwitaka. Musaagha yeene eyo, Akaduuyu kaghulira eiroboozi nga lileekaana "Lumuka kaduuyu Lumuka!" Agho obuzibu ghe butandiikira!

books.title: Olwomukaga olwokya
books.summary: Olwomukaga olwokya eigulo, abaghala basatu bagya okuzanha okumpi n'omwiga. Ghaire nga tibaikirizibwa kweghuga, mangu inho babuka bamala olweigulo lwonalwona kusambusa na kuba nabisanhusa. Bwebenda okugya ghaka ate, tibabona ngoye dhaibwe. Ki ekiyinza okuba nga kituse ku birinda byaibwe na masati? Beinhonhola ku batya eri abazaire ba bwe?

books.title: Wulirisa
books.summary: Wulirisa amaloboozi ge'bisolo ag'endhawulo.

books.title: Omusaadha asooka era omukazi asooka
books.summary: Emboozi egama ku ntandikwa ye ensi no omutntu. Batandiika nga misota egiva mu kiziikiiza enhinhogovu okwidha mu munsi yo musana enheka nheka. Bwegimala okutuuka kungulu, emisota gicuusa embeera yaagyo okutandiika obulamu obuyaaka.

books.title: Taliika ni mukagwa we
books.summary: Omwaayi omuto aghonezebwa okugwa mu bulwa ni mukagwa we. Ikaanhya kino bwe kyaali.

books.title: Emikwaano
books.summary: Olufumo olugema ku mwisuka ni bakagwa be, ni bye bendha einho okukola.

books.title: Aziizi
books.summary: Omwana ono ayenda ino okufa ku doli we. Era doli Aziizi ni mukwano gwe amusanhusa.

books.title: Maama wa'Simba omuyaaka
books.summary: Oluvainhuma lwa'maama wa'Simba okufa, baasobola okuba ni'latawe mw'isanhu okutuusa ise bwe yafuna omukazi owundi.

books.title: Musa ni puusi
books.summary: Musa talabirira puusi yeyalonda nga ava ku isomero. Aye musa ali ne ekilooto ekigema ku puusi egicuusacuusa empisa dhe embi.

books.title: Amaizi ga Nomvula
books.summary: Nomvula ataka okuzanya -naye ekisooka kisuu innu, era ate kiwolu. Ayaba okuvula nga kyobudingise okuzanya mu maizi.

books.title: Namuvula aja mu maadhi
books.summary: Namuvula ayenda okuzaanha-aye okusooka akasana kanji, kabiri ebisoodo byaba binji. Agho yaakizuula nga kinhoonha okuzaanhira mu maadhi agali kugwa.

books.title: Mokorage 'iza̱za̱bi
books.summary: This is a story about a little boy who loves to read stories. He loves it so much so that he wants to share a story with his family.

books.title: Nnhendha inho okusoma
books.summary: Luno n'olufumo olw'omulenzi ayendha einho okusoma enfumo. Ayenda inho okugabanaku ebighandiike ebindi ebigemagana ku maka.

books.title: Amagezi ga bbaabba
books.summary: Endowooza enkalamu ey'okukolamu amaka.

books.title: Akabendhe akokusuulirira maama
books.summary: Emboozi egema ku maka agaghangaliire mu irungu mu bitundu by'obugwandhuba mu mambuuka aga Turukana e Kenya.

books.title: Ekibala Ekiwoomu
books.summary: Ghali yo omughala omulungi nga buli muntu yegomba ku muwasa. Mu luya lwa amaka gaibwe, waliyo omuti nga guliku ebibala ebirungi ebiwooma. Abazaire be baasalawo nga omwana ghaibwe ali n'okufumbirwa omuntu nga abakyalira yasiibawo olunaku lwonalwona ayenga naire okulya ku kibala kyonakyona. Anaabita ekigezo ekyo nga naamughangula mu bufumbo?

books.title: Ebisolo birumuka
books.summary: Ebisolo bina ebikulu byegomba okufuna eidembe okuva ewa bakama baabyo abatasiima, era bifuna ekifo mwe biba mu myaka gyabyo egy'obukaire.

books.title: Wanume ne ente
books.summary: Wanume omulenzi omulaalo afiirwa ente dhe.

books.title: Omukulu W'eirike
books.summary: Singuli abaabira okumukulu babwirye entegeka gy'embiibbi, kyandi taasirye obulamu bwe!

books.title: Ab'omukwano bafuuka abalabe
books.summary: Wampiti omumalirirvu asobola okwega bwe kituuka ku Wakayima omugayaavu?

books.title: Wankembo ni Wangoina (Colour-in)
books.summary: Bawangoina ba bulwa, aye baidhi byebakola?

books.title: Ebisolo,Ebisolo
books.summary: Osansaannhie emigaso gy'ebisolo omubitundu byaisu.

books.title: Ensugha eyafa
books.summary: Byantaka yali n'akasugha akatono. Yeegomba ensugha enene. Yaalikozeeki? Yakozesa omutwegwe yaafuna kyeyayenda.

books.title: Wankudu ni wa kaduuyu
books.summary: Enkudu n'akamyu bali n'omulimo ogw'okukola. Banaakolera aghalala?

books.title: Isabirye ow'eitima
books.summary: Isabirye mwavu, aye mukwano gwe Kaduuyu mulimi mututumufu. Nabirye wa mwoyo mubi era afuba inho okubona nga anhaga eisamba lya mukwano gwe. Atunda ebibala n'eiva lya Wakaduuyu yaafuna empiiya embitirivu. Lulala yali ava mu kiya nga aja eka, ekintu kyabaawo ekyacuusa obulamu bwa Isabirye.

books.title: Kyennhumirwa okukola

books.summary: There was a young man who thought he was wiser than anyone young or old around him. He said so to everyone including his wife. However, his wife’s father proved to him that “old is wiser than young”.

books.title: Oku Pati Ru Ri
books.summary: This is the story of an old man who has everything he wants – except a wife. So he decides to carve one for himself, out of a tree. Some young men from a neighbouring village decide she is too beautiful for an old man. So they steal her. He is grief-stricken, and tries everything to get her back.

books.title: Arakiliko

This is a story about a young boy who found and shot a Hornbill as he was walking through the village. A Hornbill is commonly found in forests in tropical Africa. He was very excited and offered the bird to an old man in the village who liked eating anything given to him.

books.title: Si
books.summary: In this story we look at the different kinds of teeth animals have and what happens to our teeth when we start to grow up.

books.title: Nonkungu O Imbulu
books.summary: Nonkungu was going to visit her uncle and her mother gave her beautiful clothes to wear. On the way to her uncle's village, Nonkungu meets a strange girl who wants to wear the lovely clothes.

books.title: Nonkungu N’Embulu

On her way to her uncle's village, she meets a young girl across the stream who also claims to be uncle Mtonyama's niece and is also coincidentally visiting him. She complements Nonkungu on her beautiful beaded dress and asks if she can try it on. Nonkungu agrees and when they exchange clothes she then realises that the girl is really an imbulu. She is frightened. Do you think Nonkungu's journey will be smooth? What will happen to the imbulu? Read on to find out what happens in this exciting tale!

books.title: Onyukunyu Pi Drikulu Be
books.summary: Mr. Fly and Mr. Big head were two great friends. Then one day they argued about who could swim across the river. They decided to go out and swim to prove who was right. Mr. Big Head failed to swim. Mr. Fly laughed so much that his mouth became wider and wider…

books.title: Amagu Pa Ima Ati

books.title: Anji Afa Akazavile Ri

As a sign that they are always with her, she is miraculously given the gift of a very special gourd and it becomes the source of comfort and good luck. Khayanga experiences the presence of her mother through songs and this special gourd.

books.summary: This is a story of a young girl, Mulongo who went into the forest to meet her friends. However, she failed to find the path her friends had used. She took the wrong turn. She walked for a long distance but did not find her friends. Exhausted, she sat down under a tree, and soon fell asleep. She woke up when it was already dark. She was scared especially when she saw the lions that had surrounded her. Mulongo, who was to be eaten by the lions, managed to escape. Find out how she survived being eaten by the lions.

books.title: ‘Aza’Bo, Ba Aza Be Ri

books.title: Pati Efi
books.summary: In one of a faraway village, there was a very beautiful girl whom everyone wished to marry. It was difficult for the parents to decide on a right suitor for their daughter. However, in their compound they also had a very sweet fruit. They, therefore, decided that their daughter would be given to whoever visited them and stayed the whole day without eating any of the fruit.

books.title: Agu Azi Izu Ni

books.title: Ebio Pi Okukua Be

books.title: Tshihwilili Tshanga

books.title: Eshialo Shiefu Shiokhuchamisia

books.title: Ibio Pi Ondoa Be

He is so excited by all he learns from looking into it that he wants to hide it in a tree so that he can keep it all to himself. Unfortunately for him (but fortunately for the people of the world), the pot falls and breaks.

books.title: Ts'epang Le Katse Ea Lehata

E mo kopa hore ba kalimisane ka mese le sefaha nako e khuts'oane ha ba ntse ba tsamaisana tsela ho ea ha Rangoane Teboho. Ha ba fihl Katse e thetsa batho ba moo e re ke eona mochana oa Rangoane Teboho. Ts'epang e be o lula naheng pela masimo a Rangoane oa hae a ntse a bina ho fihlela bafiti ka tsela ba mo utloa ebe ba bolella Rangoane oa hae. angoane oa hae o khutla le Ts'epang e be ba etsetsa Katse leqheka ka ho mo chekela mokoti o nang le lebese. Katse e hloleha ke ho tlola mokoti e be e oela ka hare ebe Rangoane o e kupetsa ka mobu.
